articles.titleTr: BBVA CEO'su Onur Genç: "Problem teknoloji değil, finansman"
articles.summaryTr: BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç, enerji dönüşümünde mevcut teknolojilerin önemli bir ilerleme sağlamaya yeterli olduğunu, asıl meselenin projeleri finanse edilebilir hale getirmek olduğunu söyledi.
articles.articleText: BBVA CEO'su Onur Genç: "Problem teknoloji değil, finansman" - BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç, enerji dönüşümünde mevcut teknolojilerin önemli bir ilerleme sağlamaya yeterli olduğunu, asıl meselenin projeleri finanse edilebilir hale getirmek olduğunu söyledi. - Garanti BBVA Genel Müdürü Mahmut Akten ise şirketlerin kredi talebinde temel sorunun limitlerden çok fiyatlama olduğunu belirterek, yüksek faizin bilançolar üzerinde ciddi yük oluşturduğunu vurguladı. BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç ve Garanti BBVA Genel Müdürü Mahmut Akten, Antalya’da COP31 kapsamında basın mensuplarıyla bir araya geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sohbetin gündeminde enerji dönüşümü ve sürdürülebilir finansmanın yanı sıra fon krizi, kredi koşulları, bankacılıkta karlılık ve 2027 beklentileri vardı. İki yöneticinin değerlendirmelerinde, Türkiye’nin enerji bağımlılığını azaltmasının hem ekonomik kırılganlıklarla mücadele hem de şirketlerin rekabet gücü açısından taşıdığı önem öne çıktı. BBVA’dan sürdürülebilir finansmanda 1 trilyon euroluk hedef Onur Genç’e göre sürdürülebilirlik, çevresel sorumluluğun ötesine geçerek ülkelerin ve şirketlerin rekabet gücünü belirleyen bir konuya dönüştü. Enerjide dışa bağımlılık, savaşlar ve tedarik sorunları karşısında ülkelerin maliyetlerini artırırken şirketler için de hem maliyetleri yönetme hem ihracat pazarlarını koruma ihtiyacı büyüyor. Genç, “Ülkeler eğer bu konuda yatırım yapmazlarsa ülke olarak rekabet avantajını kaybediyorlar. Şirketler eğer bu konuda yatırım yapmazlarsa hem pazarlarını hem de rekabet avantajlarını yine maliyet olarak kaybediyorlar.” dedi. Sürdürülebilirliği 2018’de stratejik öncelikleri arasına alan BBVA, başlangıçta 100 milyar euro olarak belirlediği finansman hedefini önce 200 milyar, ardından 300 milyar euroya yükseltti. Grup, 2018–2024 döneminde 300 milyar euroluk sürdürülebilir finansmanı yönlendirdi. 2025–2029 dönemi için buna 700 milyar euro daha eklenmesi planlanıyor. Böylece 2018–2029 dönemindeki toplam taahhüt 1 trilyon euroya ulaşıyor. Genç’in paylaştığı rakamlara göre, 2025 başından 2026 Eylül sonuna kadar yeni hedef kapsamında 250 milyar euroluk finansman sağlandı. Türkiye’nin grubun sürdürülebilir finansmanından yüzde 10–15 pay alması bekleniyor. Bu oran, Türkiye’nin grup kârındaki yaklaşık yüzde 8’lik payının üzerinde. Emisyon hedefleri prim sistemine de bağlandı BBVA, karbon yoğun 10 sektör için belirlediği emisyon azaltım hedeflerindeki ilerlemeyi her yıl raporluyor. Hedefler, çalışanların değişken ücret ve prim sisteminde de bir performans ölçütü olarak kullanılıyor. Genç, “Dedik ki eğer o salınım eğrisinde aşağıya gitmiyorsa banka, bonusumuzun daha azını alacağız.” sözleriyle uygulamayı anlattı. Bu ölçüt yalnızca üst yönetimle sınırlı değil; değişken ücret alan çalışanların değerlendirmesinde de banka performansının bir unsuru. Akten’in aktardığına göre kredi değerlendirmelerinde şirketlerin dönüşüm performansı da ölçülüyor. Banka, dönüşüme yatırım yapan ve bu alanda yüksek skor alan şirketlerle daha fazla çalışarak kredi portföyünün emisyon yoğunluğunu azaltmayı hedefliyor. “Problem teknoloji değil, problem finansman” Elektrifikasyonda mevcut teknolojilerle önemli bir ilerleme sağlanabileceğini vurgulayan Genç, temel meselenin yatırımların bankalar açısından finanse edilebilir bir yapıya kavuşması olduğunu söyledi ve “Problem teknoloji değil. Problem finansman hakikaten,” dedi. BBVA’nın 2025 başından 2026 Eylül sonuna kadar sağladığı 250 milyar euroluk sürdürülebilir finansmanın 60 milyar eurosu elektrifikasyonla ilgili. Bunun yaklaşık yüzde 45’i yenilenebilir enerji üretimine, yüzde 55’i ise iletim, dağıtım ve nihai kullanımın elektrifikasyonu gibi alanlara yöneldi. Genç’in dikkat çektiği nokta, yeşil elektrik üretmenin tek başına yeterli olmaması. Üretimin şebeke bağlantısı, depolama ve tüketim altyapısıyla birlikte ele alınması gerekiyor. Elektrikli araçların şarj altyapısıyla, yenilenebilir enerji santrallerinin de iletim ve dağıtım hatlarıyla tamamlanması bu nedenle kritik. Finanse edilebilir projede gelir güvencesi ve risk paylaşımı öne çıkıyor Uzun vadeli enerji yatırımlarında maliyetler görece hesaplanabilir olsa da gelecekteki gelir her zaman aynı açıklıkta görülemiyor. Genç’in verdiği örnekte, bir güneş santralinin ürettiği elektriği gelecek 15 yılda hangi fiyattan satacağı, finansman kararının temel unsurlarından biri. Bu belirsizliği azaltmak için uzun vadeli alım anlaşmaları, kamu garantileri ve uluslararası kuruluşların risk paylaşım mekanizmaları öne çıkıyor. Genç, “Uzun vadeli bir proje olduğu için uzun vadeli gelir tarafında biraz daha rahat hissetmeyi istiyor bankalar” dedi. Düzenlemelerde öngörülebilirlik sağlanamaması da uzun vadeli finansmanı zorlaştıran unsurlar arasında. Akten ise üretici garantilerinin ve diğer kurumlarla risk paylaşımının finansmanı kolaylaştırdığına dikkat çekerken, "Riski tahmin edebildiğimiz zaman o riski yönetebiliyoruz, o riski fiyatlayabiliyoruz.” dedi. KOBİ'lerde finansmanın yanında yol haritası ihtiyacı var Garanti BBVA Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Cemal Onaran’a göre küçük şirketlerde dönüşümün önündeki önemli engellerden biri bilgi eksikliği. Büyük şirketler süreci daha kolay yönetebilirken küçük firmalar çoğu zaman nereden başlayacağını bilemiyor. Onaran, “Banka olarak iki tane fonksiyonumuz var. Bir finansman var, bir de bu tarafta danışmanlık işimiz var.” dedi. Bu çerçevede banka, şirketlere dönüşüm yol haritalarını oluşturmaları için destek veriyor; yatırım yapmaya hazır müşterilerin finansman ihtiyaçlarını da karşılamaya çalışıyor. Sanayide modernizasyonun maliyetlere katkısına ilişkin örnek ise Akten’den geldi. Uno’nun modernizasyon projesi için İspanya’dan sağlanan finansmanla gerçekleştirilen yatırım sonucunda enerji maliyetinde yüzde 37 düşüş elde edildi. Fon krizi: "Bankacılık sektörüne etkisi limitli" Fon krizinde Genç’in yaptığı ayrım, konunun sosyal boyutu ile bankacılık sistemine etkisi arasında oldu. Etkilenen kişi sayısı ve yaşanan mağduriyetler önemli olmakla birlikte, bankanın kendi verileri sistem üzerindeki etkinin sınırlı kaldığına işaret ediyor. Genç, “Bizim gördüğümüz, kendi rakamlarımızdan gördüğümüz, bankacılık sektörüne etkisi limitli bir konu” dedi. Sorunun belirli oyuncu ve fonlarla sınırlı bir alanda kaldığını ifade ederek, “Karantinaya alındı. Ve şu anda çözmeye çalışıyorlar.” değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Genç, tek başına bu olayın yabancı yatırımcıların Türkiye’ye bakışını değiştirmesini beklemiyor. Zaman içinde Türkiye’ye 9,3 milyar euro getiren BBVA’nın da fon krizi nedeniyle ülkeye yatırım yapmaktan vazgeçmesi söz konusu değil. "Kurumsal tarafta faiz, bireysel tarafta altın etkisi" Akten’in ekonomik talebe ilişkin değerlendirmesinde şirketler açısından faiz maliyetleri, bireysel tarafta ise altın fiyatlarındaki hareketler öne çıktı. “Kurumsal tarafta faiz, bireysel tarafta biraz önce bahsettiğimiz altının etkisi” diyen Akten, altın fiyatındaki düşüşün servet etkisi üzerinden ekonomiye yansıyabildiğine dikkat çekti. Genç de Türkiye’de hanehalkının önemli miktarda altın varlığı bulunması nedeniyle fiyatların seyrinin ekonomik görünüm açısından izlenmesi gerektiğini vurguladı. Petrol fiyatları ise enerji maliyetleri ve enflasyon üzerinden etkili oluyor. Akten’e göre yabancı yatırımcının değerlendirmesinde daha belirleyici olan unsur, TL faiz getirisiyle kurdaki değer kaybı arasındaki ilişki. "Sorun kredi limitlerinden çok fiyatlama" Şirketlerin finansmana erişiminde Akten’in öne çıkardığı sorun kredi limitinden çok maliyet oldu. Özellikle KOBİ kredilerinde bankalar arasında ciddi rekabet bulunduğunu vurgulayan Akten, şöyle konuştu: “Ben genelde şikâyetin limit vermekle alakalı değil ama fiyatlamayla alakalı olduğunu düşünüyorum. Gelen geri bildirimler de onlarla alakalı.” Uzun süredir yüksek seyreden faizler şirket bilançoları üzerinde yük oluşturuyor. Akten’e göre uygun maliyetli kredi paketlerinde talebin hızla artması da sorunun niteliğini gösteriyor: Daha uygun faiz bulunduğunda kredi talebi yükseliyor. Genç de “Bugün bence finansmana erişim problemi yok. Bence fiyat problemi var.” diyerek şirketlerin mevcut faiz seviyelerinde kredi kullanmayı tercih etmeyebildiğini ifade etti. Bankacılıkta gündem sermaye getirisi Bankacılık sektörü açısından öne çıkan başlıklardan biri, özkaynak getirisinin birkaç yıldır enflasyonun altında kalması. Akten, önümüzdeki dönemde faiz marjının, maliyetlerin ve kredi risk maliyetlerinin yönetilmesinin önemine dikkat çekti. Garanti BBVA için bu yıl yaklaşık yüzde 27,5 özkaynak getirisi bekleniyor. Akten’e göre bu oran hem enflasyonun hem de sermayedarın beklediği getirinin altında. Genç de Garanti BBVA’nın sektörde güçlü bir kârlılık performansı göstermesine rağmen sermaye getirisinin enflasyonun altında kaldığını vurguladı. İki yöneticinin değerlendirmesinde de düşük faiz ortamı bankalar açısından olumlu. Ancak bunun kalıcı olabilmesi için enflasyonda düşüş gerekiyor. Genç: "Türkiye cari açık sorununu enerji dönüşümüyle hafifletebilir" Türkiye’nin ekonomik kırılganlıklarına ilişkin değerlendirmesinde Genç, enerji ithalatı ile cari açık arasındaki bağa dikkat çekti. Türkiye’nin geçmişte yaşadığı birçok ekonomik dalgalanmanın temelinde cari açık ve dış finansmana bağımlılık bulunduğunu ifade etti. Genç, “Şu cari açık konusunu çözmeden biz ülke olarak her zaman politik durumlardan bağımsız bir kırılganlıkla karşı karşıya olacağız.” dedi. Genç’e göre enerji dönüşümü, bu kırılganlığı azaltmanın başlıca araçlarından biri. Enerji maliyetleri ve arz güvenliğinde daha güçlü bir konuma ulaşmak, ülke ekonomisinin yanı sıra şirketlerin rekabet gücünü de destekleyecek. Avrupa’ya ihracat yapan şirketler açısından ise karbon düzenlemelerine hazırlık önem taşıyor. Dönüşüm, hem üretim maliyetleri hem de ana ihracat pazarına erişim açısından değerlendirilmesi gereken bir konu. 2027’de enflasyon ve faiz için temkinli beklenti Genç, 2027’de enflasyonun yüzde 25–30 aralığında olmasını beklediklerini, ancak enerji fiyatları ve diğer dış etkenler nedeniyle belirsizliğin yüksek olduğunu söyledi. Daha net bir tahmin için yıl sonunun görülmesi gerekiyor. Faizlerdeki hareket alanı da enflasyonun seyrine bağlı. “Faizlerin düşebilmesi için enflasyonun düşmesi lazım.” diyen Genç, enflasyonda belirgin gerileme yaşanmaması halinde faizlerde de düşüş alanının sınırlı kalacağına işaret etti. Akten’in izlenmesi gerektiğini vurguladığı değişkenler arasında enerji fiyatlarının yanında asgari ücret artışı ve bunun özellikle hizmet sektöründeki maliyetlere etkisi de bulunuyor. 2027 gündemi: Depolama, şebeke, verimlilik ve yapay zekâ Genç’in aktardığı eğilimlere göre sürdürülebilir finansmanda yenilenebilir enerji üretimi ağırlığını koruyor. Bunun yanında depolama, elektrik iletim ve dağıtım altyapısı ile sanayide enerji verimliliği giderek daha fazla öne çıkıyor. Akten’in paylaştığı rakamlara göre Garanti BBVA’nın güneş ve rüzgâr alanında bugüne kadar sağladığı finansman 8 milyar dolara ulaştı. Önümüzdeki dönemde şebeke yatırımlarının da artması bekleniyor. Bankacılığın diğer önemli gündemi ise yapay zekâ. Genç, bu teknolojinin operasyonel süreçlerde verimlilik, dolandırıcılıkla mücadele ve müşteriye özel hizmetler açısından büyük fırsatlar sunduğunu vurguladı. Bu dönüşüm siber güvenlik risklerini de büyütüyor. Genç’e göre teknolojiye kaynak ayırabilen bankalar, hem fırsatları değerlendirme hem de riskleri yönetme kapasitesiyle yeni dönemde farklılaşabilecek.

Emisyon hedefleri prim sistemine de bağlandı BBVA, karbon yoğun 10 sektör için belirlediği emisyon azaltım hedeflerindeki ilerlemeyi her yıl raporluyor. Hedefler, çalışanların değişken ücret ve prim sisteminde de bir performans ölçütü olarak kullanılıyor. Genç, “Dedik ki eğer o salınım eğrisinde aşağıya gitmiyorsa banka, bonusumuzun daha azını alacağız.” sözleriyle uygulamayı anlattı. Bu ölçüt yalnızca üst yönetimle sınırlı değil; değişken ücret alan çalışanların değerlendirmesinde de banka performansının bir unsuru. Akten’in aktardığına göre kredi değerlendirmelerinde şirketlerin dönüşüm performansı da ölçülüyor. Banka, dönüşüme yatırım yapan ve bu alanda yüksek skor alan şirketlerle daha fazla çalışarak kredi portföyünün emisyon yoğunluğunu azaltmayı hedefliyor. “Problem teknoloji değil, problem finansman” Elektrifikasyonda mevcut teknolojilerle önemli bir ilerleme sağlanabileceğini vurgulayan Genç, temel meselenin yatırımların bankalar açısından finanse edilebilir bir yapıya kavuşması olduğunu söyledi ve “Problem teknoloji değil. Problem finansman hakikaten,” dedi. BBVA’nın 2025 başından 2026 Eylül sonuna kadar sağladığı 250 milyar euroluk sürdürülebilir finansmanın 60 milyar eurosu elektrifikasyonla ilgili. Bunun yaklaşık yüzde 45’i yenilenebilir enerji üretimine, yüzde 55’i ise iletim, dağıtım ve nihai kullanımın elektrifikasyonu gibi alanlara yöneldi. Genç’in dikkat çektiği nokta, yeşil elektrik üretmenin tek başına yeterli olmaması. Üretimin şebeke bağlantısı, depolama ve tüketim altyapısıyla birlikte ele alınması gerekiyor. Elektrikli araçların şarj altyapısıyla, yenilenebilir enerji santrallerinin de iletim ve dağıtım hatlarıyla tamamlanması bu nedenle kritik. Finanse edilebilir projede gelir güvencesi ve risk paylaşımı öne çıkıyor Uzun vadeli enerji yatırımlarında maliyetler görece hesaplanabilir olsa da gelecekteki gelir her zaman aynı açıklıkta görülemiyor. Genç’in verdiği örnekte, bir güneş santralinin ürettiği elektriği gelecek 15 yılda hangi fiyattan satacağı, finansman kararının temel unsurlarından biri. Bu belirsizliği azaltmak için uzun vadeli alım anlaşmaları, kamu garantileri ve uluslararası kuruluşların risk paylaşım mekanizmaları öne çıkıyor. Genç, “Uzun vadeli bir proje olduğu için uzun vadeli gelir tarafında biraz daha rahat hissetmeyi istiyor bankalar” dedi. Düzenlemelerde öngörülebilirlik sağlanamaması da uzun vadeli finansmanı zorlaştıran unsurlar arasında. Akten ise üretici garantilerinin ve diğer kurumlarla risk paylaşımının finansmanı kolaylaştırdığına dikkat çekerken, "Riski tahmin edebildiğimiz zaman o riski yönetebiliyoruz, o riski fiyatlayabiliyoruz.” dedi. KOBİ'lerde finansmanın yanında yol haritası ihtiyacı var Garanti BBVA Genel Müdür Yardımcısı Cemal Onaran’a göre küçük şirketlerde dönüşümün önündeki önemli engellerden biri bilgi eksikliği. Büyük şirketler süreci daha kolay yönetebilirken küçük firmalar çoğu zaman nereden başlayacağını bilemiyor. Onaran, “Banka olarak iki tane fonksiyonumuz var. Bir finansman var, bir de bu tarafta danışmanlık işimiz var.” dedi. Bu çerçevede banka, şirketlere dönüşüm yol haritalarını oluşturmaları için destek veriyor; yatırım yapmaya hazır müşterilerin finansman ihtiyaçlarını da karşılamaya çalışıyor. Sanayide modernizasyonun maliyetlere katkısına ilişkin örnek ise Akten’den geldi. Uno’nun modernizasyon projesi için İspanya’dan sağlanan finansmanla gerçekleştirilen yatırım sonucunda enerji maliyetinde yüzde 37 düşüş elde edildi. Fon krizi: "Bankacılık sektörüne etkisi limitli" Fon krizinde Genç’in yaptığı ayrım, konunun sosyal boyutu ile bankacılık sistemine etkisi arasında oldu. Etkilenen kişi sayısı ve yaşanan mağduriyetler önemli olmakla birlikte, bankanın kendi verileri sistem üzerindeki etkinin sınırlı kaldığına işaret ediyor. Genç, “Bizim gördüğümüz, kendi rakamlarımızdan gördüğümüz, bankacılık sektörüne etkisi limitli bir konu” dedi. Sorunun belirli oyuncu ve fonlarla sınırlı bir alanda kaldığını ifade ederek, “Karantinaya alındı. Ve şu anda çözmeye çalışıyorlar.” değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Genç, tek başına bu olayın yabancı yatırımcıların Türkiye’ye bakışını değiştirmesini beklemiyor. Zaman içinde Türkiye’ye 9,3 milyar euro getiren BBVA’nın da fon krizi nedeniyle ülkeye yatırım yapmaktan vazgeçmesi söz konusu değil. "Kurumsal tarafta faiz, bireysel tarafta altın etkisi" Akten’in ekonomik talebe ilişkin değerlendirmesinde şirketler açısından faiz maliyetleri, bireysel tarafta ise altın fiyatlarındaki hareketler öne çıktı. “Kurumsal tarafta faiz, bireysel tarafta biraz önce bahsettiğimiz altının etkisi” diyen Akten, altın fiyatındaki düşüşün servet etkisi üzerinden ekonomiye yansıyabildiğine dikkat çekti. Genç de Türkiye’de hanehalkının önemli miktarda altın varlığı bulunması nedeniyle fiyatların seyrinin ekonomik görünüm açısından izlenmesi gerektiğini vurguladı. Petrol fiyatları ise enerji maliyetleri ve enflasyon üzerinden etkili oluyor. Akten’e göre yabancı yatırımcının değerlendirmesinde daha belirleyici olan unsur, TL faiz getirisiyle kurdaki değer kaybı arasındaki ilişki. "Sorun kredi limitlerinden çok fiyatlama" Şirketlerin finansmana erişiminde Akten’in öne çıkardığı sorun kredi limitinden çok maliyet oldu. Özellikle KOBİ kredilerinde bankalar arasında ciddi rekabet bulunduğunu vurgulayan Akten, şöyle konuştu: “Ben genelde şikâyetin limit vermekle alakalı değil ama fiyatlamayla alakalı olduğunu düşünüyorum. Gelen geri bildirimler de onlarla alakalı.” Uzun süredir yüksek seyreden faizler şirket bilançoları üzerinde yük oluşturuyor. Akten’e göre uygun maliyetli kredi paketlerinde talebin hızla artması da sorunun niteliğini gösteriyor: Daha uygun faiz bulunduğunda kredi talebi yükseliyor. Genç de “Bugün bence finansmana erişim problemi yok. Bence fiyat problemi var.” diyerek şirketlerin mevcut faiz seviyelerinde kredi kullanmayı tercih etmeyebildiğini ifade etti. Bankacılıkta gündem sermaye getirisi Bankacılık sektörü açısından öne çıkan başlıklardan biri, özkaynak getirisinin birkaç yıldır enflasyonun altında kalması. Akten, önümüzdeki dönemde faiz marjının, maliyetlerin ve kredi risk maliyetlerinin yönetilmesinin önemine dikkat çekti. Garanti BBVA için bu yıl yaklaşık yüzde 27,5 özkaynak getirisi bekleniyor. Akten’e göre bu oran hem enflasyonun hem de sermayedarın beklediği getirinin altında. Genç de Garanti BBVA’nın sektörde güçlü bir kârlılık performansı göstermesine rağmen sermaye getirisinin enflasyonun altında kaldığını vurguladı. İki yöneticinin değerlendirmesinde de düşük faiz ortamı bankalar açısından olumlu. Ancak bunun kalıcı olabilmesi için enflasyonda düşüş gerekiyor. Genç: "Türkiye cari açık sorununu enerji dönüşümüyle hafifletebilir" Türkiye’nin ekonomik kırılganlıklarına ilişkin değerlendirmesinde Genç, enerji ithalatı ile cari açık arasındaki bağa dikkat çekti. Türkiye’nin geçmişte yaşadığı birçok ekonomik dalgalanmanın temelinde cari açık ve dış finansmana bağımlılık bulunduğunu ifade etti. Genç, “Şu cari açık konusunu çözmeden biz ülke olarak her zaman politik durumlardan bağımsız bir kırılganlıkla karşı karşıya olacağız.” dedi. Genç’e göre enerji dönüşümü, bu kırılganlığı azaltmanın başlıca araçlarından biri. Enerji maliyetleri ve arz güvenliğinde daha güçlü bir konuma ulaşmak, ülke ekonomisinin yanı sıra şirketlerin rekabet gücünü de destekleyecek. Avrupa’ya ihracat yapan şirketler açısından ise karbon düzenlemelerine hazırlık önem taşıyor. Dönüşüm, hem üretim maliyetleri hem de ana ihracat pazarına erişim açısından değerlendirilmesi gereken bir konu. 2027’de enflasyon ve faiz için temkinli beklenti Genç, 2027’de enflasyonun yüzde 25–30 aralığında olmasını beklediklerini, ancak enerji fiyatları ve diğer dış etkenler nedeniyle belirsizliğin yüksek olduğunu söyledi. Daha net bir tahmin için yıl sonunun görülmesi gerekiyor. Faizlerdeki hareket alanı da enflasyonun seyrine bağlı. “Faizlerin düşebilmesi için enflasyonun düşmesi lazım.” diyen Genç, enflasyonda belirgin gerileme yaşanmaması halinde faizlerde de düşüş alanının sınırlı kalacağına işaret etti. Akten’in izlenmesi gerektiğini vurguladığı değişkenler arasında enerji fiyatlarının yanında asgari ücret artışı ve bunun özellikle hizmet sektöründeki maliyetlere etkisi de bulunuyor. 2027 gündemi: Depolama, şebeke, verimlilik ve yapay zekâ Genç’in aktardığı eğilimlere göre sürdürülebilir finansmanda yenilenebilir enerji üretimi ağırlığını koruyor. Bunun yanında depolama, elektrik iletim ve dağıtım altyapısı ile sanayide enerji verimliliği giderek daha fazla öne çıkıyor. Akten’in paylaştığı rakamlara göre Garanti BBVA’nın güneş ve rüzgâr alanında bugüne kadar sağladığı finansman 8 milyar dolara ulaştı. Önümüzdeki dönemde şebeke yatırımlarının da artması bekleniyor. Bankacılığın diğer önemli gündemi ise yapay zekâ. Genç, bu teknolojinin operasyonel süreçlerde verimlilik, dolandırıcılıkla mücadele ve müşteriye özel hizmetler açısından büyük fırsatlar sunduğunu vurguladı. Bu dönüşüm siber güvenlik risklerini de büyütüyor. Genç’e göre teknolojiye kaynak ayırabilen bankalar, hem fırsatları değerlendirme hem de riskleri yönetme kapasitesiyle yeni dönemde farklılaşabilecek.

articles.title: Nvidia'nın eski CEO'su Huang, ABD Kongresi'nde ifade verecek
articles.summary: ABD'li çip devi Nvidia'nın eski CEO'su Jensen Huang, ulusal güvenlik tehditlerinin ele alınacağı kapalı oturumda Kongre'ye ifade vermeyi kabul etti. İfadenin Şükran Günü tatilinden önce yapılması bekleniyor.

articles.titleTr: Nvidia'nın eski CEO'su Huang, ABD Kongresi'nde ifade verecek

articles.articleText: Nvidia'nın eski CEO'su Huang, ABD Kongresi'nde ifade verecek - ABD'li çip devi Nvidia'nın eski CEO'su Jensen Huang, ulusal güvenlik tehditlerinin ele alınacağı kapalı oturumda Kongre'ye ifade vermeyi kabul etti. - İfadenin Şükran Günü tatilinden önce yapılması bekleniyor. ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia'nın eski Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Jensen Huang, ABD Kongresi'nde ulusal güvenlik konularının ele alınacağı kapalı oturumda ifade verecek. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Temsilciler Meclisi Dış İlişkiler Komitesi Başkanı Cumhuriyetçi Brian Mast, Huang'ın ifade vermeyi kabul ettiğini açıkladı. ABD Kongre binasında gazetecilere konuşan Mast, oturumun tarihi konusunda görüşmelerin sürdüğünü belirtti. İfadesi kayıt altına alınacak Huang'ın kasım ayının sonundaki Şükran Günü tatilinden önce Kongre'de yeminli ifade vermesinin beklendiğini aktaran Mast, ifadenin video kaydına alınacağını ve tutanak tutulacağını bildirdi. Oturuma Temsilciler Meclisi Dış İlişkiler Komitesi'nin yanı sıra Çin Özel Komitesi ve İstihbarat Komitesi'nin de katılması bekleniyor. Nvidia'dan ayrılık açıklaması Nvidia, bugün yaptığı açıklamada Jensen Huang'ın şirketin yönetim kurulu başkanlığı, CEO'luk ve yönetim kurulu üyeliği görevlerinden derhal geçerli olmak üzere ayrıldığını duyurmuştu. Huang'ın ayrılığı, biri Çin adına istihbarat topladığı öne sürülen bir kadınla olmak üzere evlilik dışı iki ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından gündeme gelmişti.

articles.title: Fed'den 2027 takviminde dikkat çeken değişiklik: Bir toplantıda faiz kararı yok
articles.summary: ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 26-27 Ekim 2027'deki toplantısında faiz kararı açıklamayacak. Fed yetkilileri bu toplantıda faiz yerine bankanın geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisini ele alacak.

articles.titleTr: Fed'den 2027 takviminde dikkat çeken değişiklik: Bir toplantıda faiz kararı yok
articles.summaryTr: ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 26-27 Ekim 2027'deki toplantısında faiz kararı açıklamayacak. Fed yetkilileri bu toplantıda faiz yerine bankanın geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisini ele alacak.
articles.articleText: Fed'den 2027 takviminde dikkat çeken değişiklik: Bir toplantıda faiz kararı yok - ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 26-27 Ekim 2027'deki toplantısında faiz kararı açıklamayacak. - Fed yetkilileri bu toplantıda faiz yerine bankanın geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisini ele alacak. ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 2027 yılı Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) toplantı takviminde değişikliğe gitti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Banka, gelecek yıl yapılacak sekiz toplantıdan birinin genel para politikası stratejisine ayrılacağını duyurdu. Fed'in açıklamasına göre FOMC, 2027'de ocak, mart, nisan, haziran, temmuz, eylül, ekim ve kasım aylarında toplanacak. Ancak 26-27 Ekim tarihlerindeki toplantı diğerlerinden farklı olacak. Söz konusu toplantıda geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisi konuları tartışılacak. Komite, bu toplantının ardından olağan şekilde faiz kararını açıklamayacak ve politika bildirisi yayımlamayacak. Fed Başkanı Warsh daha önce duyurmuştu Fed Başkanı Kevin Warsh, geçen ayki para politikası toplantısının ardından yaptığı açıklamada, gelecek yıl toplantı takviminde değişikliğe gidileceğini belirtmişti. Warsh, 2027'deki sekiz toplantıdan birinin genel para politikası stratejisine odaklanacağını ve bu toplantıda faiz kararı için oylama yapılmasının ya da politika açıklaması yayımlanmasının öngörülmediğini ifade etmişti. Fed, para politikası stratejisini düzenli aralıklarla gözden geçirerek enflasyon ve istihdam hedeflerine ulaşmak için kullandığı yaklaşımı değerlendiriyor. 2027'deki ekim toplantısının da bu kapsamlı değerlendirmeye ayrılması planlanıyor.

articles.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
articles.summary: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

articles.titleTr: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
articles.summaryTr: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
articles.articleText: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group - Published US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has awarded a medal to the guard who reprimanded his group at Arlington National Cemetery. A video of a Veterans Day observance event on Wednesday showed Hegseth, his wife, and senior advisers laughing and talking while posing for photos in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier before the guard told them to be quiet. In a statement, the Pentagon later announced that Hegseth had given Specialist Thomas Iglesias a Joint Service Commendation Medal "for the execution of his duties at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier". Photos shared on the defence secretary's X account showed him presenting the medal to Iglesias. He was accompanied by others whom the Pentagon identified as members of the 3rd US Infantry Regiment, known as the Old Guard, which is responsible for holding vigil over the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. "We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist. Carry on Patriots," the accompanying text on Hegseth's post reads. articles.title: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
articles.summary: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.

articles.titleTr: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
articles.summaryTr: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.
articles.articleText: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal - Published Jensen Huang, known for sporting a black leather jacket to shareholder events, appeared to have it all. He was courted by leaders in the US and China alike, worshipped by investors and seen as a loyal family man. But a rockstar approach to his personal life has ultimately led to his resignation. The 63-year-old has been married since 1985, long before the foundation of Nvidia, the company that propelled him to tech stardom. He is known as a workaholic and a demanding manager, with high standards for those who worked for him, which included his own children, promoted within the company. But he has seen his personal reputation go into freefall this week, undone by romantic entanglements that throw doubt on his focus and his judgement. On Thursday, he resigned following back-to-back revelations of two affairs. News of the first - a relationship with a businesswoman alleged to be a Chinese spy - ricocheted around the world, raising eyebrows among investors. It was followed on Wednesday by reports that the tech boss had also had an affair with an Nvidia colleague. His departure creates uncertainty in the global stock market, which was already knocked-off balance in recent weeks. Nvidia is a linchpin in the US's race for technology leadership with China. Huang may not be a household name on the same level as Elon Musk or Mark Zuckerberg. But his role in the tech industry, especially in relation to the explosion of artificial intelligence in the last three years, may prove more consequential. Nvidia dominates the market for the microchips that are used to power the new technology. The company, which is still valued at nearly $4n (£3.02tn) despite recent events, is at the centre of the AI race between the US and China, the world's tech and economic powerhouses. Huang enjoyed access to the seats of political power on an unrivalled scale, being courted by both US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping. His remarkable rise to the top of his profession has led to him being dubbed the "Taylor Swift of tech" and seen him amass an estimated fortune of $145bn, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. Despite always donning his trademark all-black outfits and taking a playful approach to investor presentations, Huang has worked for years to present himself as a family man, someone who exemplified the American Dream. Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang and his family moved to the west coast of the US when he was nine years old. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a Master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. It was at college where he met his wife, Lori Mills. The pair were lab partners and married in 1985, eight years before Huang founded Nvidia. They have two children, Madison and Spencer, who now both work in senior roles at Nvidia. The company became a key provider of the computer chips and circuits used for gaming before it expanded in a new direction. It now creates the key processing chips used to power the growing AI technology. Huang has hailed AI as a "new industrial revolution" that is on par with the advent of electricity. Nvidia is the world's second most valuable company and its customers include the biggest firms on the planet, Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, SpaceX, Tesla, OpenAI and Anthropic, all spending big on its products. So it is no surprise that at a recent AI summit at the White House, Huang was picked out from a group of 42 to flank the president, alongside Elon Musk, both men with whom Trump has famously close relationships. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Jensen Huang, told the BBC, referring to the late boss of Apple. He added that Huang was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. He described him as a "demanding" boss, who "really pushes his people to the limit". But while the former Nvidia CEO is "very brilliant" and a "world-class computer scientist", there's also "a level of arrogance" and "a level of self-deception as well", he said. Huang had gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, he added, something that was "very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," Witt added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." First reports emerged on 29 October in the New York Times that Huang had conducted a relationship with Alice Huang, no relation. US officials allege the businesswoman associated with Singapore-based firm Megaspeed is a Chinese intelligence asset. After the revelations of the first affair, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting their family. Trump, as well as other leaders in the AI tech industry, initially backed Huang to continue in his role at Nvidia. The president described him as "honourable". But the reporting of a second affair, with Kimberly Powell, vice president of healthcare who has worked at Nvidia for 18 years, prompted a board meeting, followed by the announcement Huang was stepping down. In the aftermath of that news Trump said Huang had done "a fantastic job" and proposed Tim Cook of Apple as a suitable replacement at the head of Nvidia.

articles.summary: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

articles.titleTr: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
articles.summaryTr: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
articles.articleText: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says - Published Six people have been killed and about 30 injured in an Israeli air strike on Nasser hospital in the southern Gaza Strip, the Hamas-run health ministry says. The hospital's director said two missiles hit a building containing surgical wards and intensive care units overnight, but that one of the missiles did not explode. The health ministry said medical staff, patients and companions were killed, among them surgeon Dr Rizq Abu Shaira. It condemned the attack as a "flagrant violation of international laws and conventions". The Israeli military said it targeted a commander of Hamas's armed wing and other fighters who had used the hospital as a "headquarters" to plan attacks on its forces. Hamas said that Israel was spreading "false narratives" in a "blatant attempt to cover up a new war crime". Under international law, hospitals have a protected status, but they have been repeatedly targeted during the Gaza war. Israel accuses Hamas, which retains security control of parts of Gaza not occupied by Israeli troops, of cynically exploiting civilian infrastructure. It says the group stores weapons and runs command and control rooms in hospitals, which Hamas denies. Israel does not allow international news organisations, including the BBC, into Gaza, making it difficult to verify what is happening in the territory. The Nasser Medical Complex is located in the city of Khan Younis and is the largest hospital in southern Gaza, serving almost one million people. In a video posted on social media, a paramedic from the Hamas-run Civil Defence agency who arrived at the building after the strike early on Thursday said a missile penetrated the five-storey structure and hit a room in the surgical department. Other footage shared by activists showed thick smoke inside the building and extensive destruction on the second floor, where medical equipment and beds had been scattered by an explosion. The hospital's director, Dr Ahmed al-Fara, later told a news conference that Israeli forces had fired two missiles at the al-Yasin surgery building but that only one exploded. "What's happened in Nasser Medical Complex is targeting the health sector mainly. We are talking about doctors, we are talking about civilians, we are talking about patients," he said. "Also, there is... huge damage [to] the infrastructure inside the hospital." Footage filmed by a freelance journalist working for the BBC showed extensive damage to an operating theatre, wards and a sleeping area for medics, as well as hallways and lifts. News agencies also published photos that appeared to show an unexploded missile. Dr Mohammed Qdeih, a general surgery specialist who was wounded in the head, said he and other medical staff had just finished work around 00:30 and had been preparing to go to sleep when there was an explosion. "My whole body was trapped under the rubble. For a moment, I felt as if I was about to lose consciousness, or that I was about to die," he told the BBC. "I started struggling to free myself and started calling out, 'Guys! Guys!' I began crawling, trying to pull my leg out from beneath the rubble. I managed to pull myself free. It was dark, there were no lights, nothing at all." He said he had been lying in a bed near Dr Rizq Abu Shaira, who was killed. Another colleague suffered a broken leg. "Dr Rizq was the kindest person in this department. He was very kind and always willing to help... And of course, he was a surgeon, one of the best among us." He added: "Patients were killed as well. There were patients in the rooms next to us who were killed. A patient comes to the hospital seeking treatment and leaves carried on people's shoulders. I do not know what kind of humanity this is." The Israeli military said in a statement that its "precise strike" had targeted the commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, who it named as Mohammed Abu Ismail, alongside other fighters who were "hiding inside" Nasser hospital. "The terrorists were struck in order to remove the threat they posed after turning the Nasser hospital compound into a headquarters and operating from there to advance dozens of terrorist plots against our forces and restore the brigade's force," it alleged. The military added that it had issued advance warnings before the strike and released an audio recording of what it said was one given to a senior Gaza health official. But Fara insisted the hospital had received no warning of an attack. A Hamas statement rejected the Israeli military's accusations, calling them "a blatant attempt to justify a documented crime targeting a civilian medical facility whose function and purpose are well known". "The nature of the targeted site and the casualties inflicted on patients, doctors and medical staff expose the falsity and weakness of this narrative," it said. However, local activists circulated claims overnight that the strike may have targeted a senior Hamas security figure who was hiding inside the building. Fara said this was the seventh time that Nasser hospital had been struck during the war. In August 2025, a double Israeli strike killed 22 Palestinians, including journalists and health workers. The World Health Organization (WHO) said it had documented a total of 1,056 attacks on healthcare in Gaza over the past three years, resulting in 1,010 deaths. "Gaza's health facilities are lifelines for its people. They must be protected. They must never be militarized or attacked," warned Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the UN agency's director general. Later on Thursday, at least four more Palestinians were reportedly killed in separate incidents in northern and central Gaza. Medics said three were killed in Israeli air strikes in Gaza City, Jabalia and Deir al-Balah, while the fourth was killed by Israeli gunfire in Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military said it struck a "terrorist" in Deir al-Balah and another in Gaza City. Israeli strikes on Gaza take place almost daily despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas in October last year. More than 1,620 people have been killed in Gaza since then, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel says six of its soldiers have been killed in Gaza over the same period. The humanitarian situation in Gaza also remains dire and has recently deteriorated further as a result of heavy rains last weekend that reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced families. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,650 people have been killed in Gaza, the health ministry says. - Published2 days ago

articles.titleTr: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
articles.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive has left the company following reports of a second extramarital affair.
articles.articleText: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations - Published One of the AI industry's most important figures has resigned amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now he has resigned after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. How was Huang removed? Nvidia's board met on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. It had 11 directors on its board, including Huang. The firm's CEO could be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors. But that wasn't in the end needed - the board instead announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and board member. It thanked him for his "immeasurable contributions" to Nvidia, which it said were "profound". There was no mention of the accusations of adultery. Who will replace him? Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. It is less clear is who will replace Huang on a permanent basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. And there is also the option of Ian Buck, who runs high-performance computing at the firm. He developed the technology which allowed graphics cards to be used for other computing tasks, which enabled Nvidia to capitalise on the growth of AI. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. She had previously been photographed with him on several occasions. The tech giant's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the west coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with US President Donald Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. She was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, which the firm said had been investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singaporean government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published2 days ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published3 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published2 days ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for gaming. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him." "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. "But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

articles.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
articles.summary: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns

articles.titleTr: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
articles.summaryTr: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
articles.articleText: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says - Published Hundreds of millions of dollars meant to help tackle Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo are not reaching the intended recipients, a medical charity has warned. A report from Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said that while the outbreak remained "out of control", front-line workers were going unpaid, lacked proper training and were struggling with shortages of essential supplies. It added that in some cases ambulances had run out of fuel. More than 5,400 people have died and 11,000 infected with Ebola in DR Congo since the outbreak was declared in May. This makes it the second-most deadly outbreak of the disease ever recorded. MSF has urged the Congolese government and UN agencies to "strengthen oversight and accountability" to ensure money already disbursed is effectively utilised. This means "ensuring response personnel are properly trained, paid, equipped, and supported, and directing resources towards areas where needs are greatest", it said. The BBC has asked the Congolese government for comment. MSF's warning adds to concerns raised by Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) last month, when it said that $700m (£527m) out of $962m disbursed to organisations implementing Ebola response was unaccounted for. At the time, Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya said it was too early to describe it as embezzlement, characterising the issue as a major transparency and financial reporting failure. The Congolese health minister echoed these concerns, saying that aid agencies were required to provide details of their work so the ministry could provide oversight but that only 22% had done so. "Our requirement is clear: transparency must be total. The response relies on a single plan, a single budget, and a single coordination," Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said on X., external - What is Ebola and why is stopping the latest outbreak so difficult? - Published15 September In its report, external, the charity said: "Despite the vast amounts of money provided for the response, many frontline responders are left trying to contain the outbreak with empty hands and empty pockets." It also mentioned Ebola monitoring "surveillance teams that exist on paper but are nowhere to be seen on the ground". "Our teams are often left speechless by the dysfunctions they witness in many areas. Six months into the response, this situation is simply unacceptable," said MSF president Javid Abdelmoneim. One important way of stopping Ebola from spreading is contact tracing - finding all those people who had come into contact with an infected person and putting them into isolation. "Despite the resources officially allocated to this critical activity, surveillance remains deeply problematic," MSF said, adding that two-thirds of deaths were occurring in communities not treatment centres. According to British epidemiologist Neil Ferguson, more than half of the cases are going undetected, meaning the outbreak is likely to last another year, reports the Reuters news agency. MSF also raised concerns over "excessive concentration" of efforts in certain areas at the expense of other areas where needs were more urgent. It said the response was "too slow" in North Kivu province while Haut-Uélé remained "dramatically overlooked". In both provinces, MSF observed that teams were "inadequately resourced to respond effectively" with health facilities lacking essential items such as water, chlorine or triage systems. "This has turned some facilities into new centres of transmission, rather than places of care that contribute to containing the disease," MSF said. The epicentre of the outbreak is in eastern DR Congo, which has been wracked by conflict for many decades, with some affected areas under rebel control. There are very few good roads in the area, making it very hard to travel around. On Thursday, the UN and government warned that the areas worst affected by Ebola were also suffering from a severe food crisis, with almost 10 million in the region in dire need. The latest outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus, has spread beyond DR Congo borders, with cases reported in Kenya, Uganda and Nigeria. On Wednesday, the last person infected with Ebola in Kenya was discharged, marking a major milestone in efforts to contain the disease in the East African nation. The Bundibugyo species is relatively rare and has no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way. Additional reporting by Emery Makumeno in Kinshasa More about the Ebola outbreak from the BBC: Go to BBCAfrica.com, external for more news from the African continent. articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
news.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
news.summaryTr: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
news.articleText: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say - Published Some young people could see reductions to the benefits they are entitled to under a radical overhaul of the welfare system to be recommended by a government-commissioned review. As reported in the Times,, external Alan Milburn's year-long report, to be published on Tuesday, is expected to recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits. Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, has been tasked by the government with helping reduce the one in eight 16 to 24 year-olds in the UK who are not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet". He said on Wednesday night that his plans would not be "pain-free" and would affect both existing and new claimants. His report is expected to say that under-25s should no longer be able to claim the health element of UK-wide universal credit - or personal independence payment (Pip), the main disability benefit in England and Wales. Disabled people in Scotland can claim the devolved Adult Disability Payment. Instead, under Milburn's plan, under-25s would receive an allowance on the same basic rate as universal credit. Some could be eligible for a new "additional cost allowance" to cover day-to-day costs related to their conditions. Some claimants would receive less under the plans - although the exact amounts will not be clear until early next year, when the government publishes legislation to implement the changes. People can claim Pip to help them with the additional cost of being disabled or living with long-term physical or mental health conditions. It is available to those both in and out of work. In his interim report,, external Milburn said survey data found that 19% of young people claiming disability or health benefits were in work. Milburn, a Labour MP from 1992 to 2010, is also expected to recommend an investment of billions into more employment support for young people, including work placements, job subsidies and one-to-one personal advisers. Those with more severe disabilities and unable to work would get a new benefit paid at a higher rate. Milburn told the Times: "Candidly, it could mean that some people will get less financial support at the beginning of their benefit claim than under the current system. "But actually, for young people, there's a different debate that we've got to resolve, which is whether the priority is their longer-term life chances or just their immediate shorter-term finances. "I think what the current system does [is] it prioritises the latter over the former. I believe that's the wrong choice and it needs to be the other way around." Speaking later on Thursday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said young people would be given support "when they need it as teenagers rather than leaving them on benefits in their 20s". He added: "The principle that we will be working on is that we will guarantee support for young people and that is the whole basis on which we will proceed." Just under one million young people in the UK are Neets, data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) from April to June suggests. This was a rise of 3% on the same period last year. Milburn's recommendations are likely to be backed by Prime Minister Andy Burnham but could prove controversial among Labour MPs, who opposed welfare changes last year under his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer. Dame Meg Hillier, who helped spearhead a backbench rebellion against Starmer's reforms, suggested she and her colleagues were broadly supportive this time around. "What happened last year was a cut was being proposed and none of us could explain to people what would happen to them," the Labour MP told the BBC. "Milburn has done some very good work on this so I'm giving him a fair wind," she added. But Bell Ribeiro-Addy, one of the Labour backbenchers who revolted last year, said she was "not sure" she could vote to cut the benefit entitlement of existing claimants. 'Cannot assume' Tom Ashforth, a 19-year-old student at Sheffield Hallam University, receives both components of Pip at the higher rate. He said the financial support helps him manage additional expenses linked to his visual impairment, including prescriptions, mobility aids and accessible learning resources. "If I were to lose it, I would struggle to afford essential things," he said. He said he believes decisions over disability benefits should be made on a case-by-case basis, rather than according to age. "You cannot assume that everyone under the age of 25 is in the same position," he said. In his Times interview, Milburn acknowledged that changing the rules for existing claimants would be "difficult politically" but stressed it was necessary. 'Rebuilding system from scratch' James Taylor, from disability equality charity Scope, said Pip was a "lifeline" and restricting access to it "won't make young disabled people's extra costs disappear". Harriet Edwards, from the charity Sense, said changes were "long overdue", but that without additional details, families were "deeply anxious". A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. Responding on Thursday, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the government should not be spending "lots of time" on employment schemes, which she said would ultimately fail. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. In an interview recorded on Tuesday, Skills Minister Jacqui Smith told the BBC that young people had a "responsibility" to take up employment support. "It is a contract. People need the chance, and they need to take that chance," she added. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disability benefits is also expected to be published this month. He said he believes decisions over disability benefits should be made on a case-by-case basis, rather than according to age. "You cannot assume that everyone under the age of 25 is in the same position," he said. In his Times interview, Milburn acknowledged that changing the rules for existing claimants would be "difficult politically" but stressed it was necessary. 'Rebuilding system from scratch' James Taylor, from disability equality charity Scope, said Pip was a "lifeline" and restricting access to it "won't make young disabled people's extra costs disappear". Harriet Edwards, from the charity Sense, said changes were "long overdue", but that without additional details, families were "deeply anxious". A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. Responding on Thursday, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the government should not be spending "lots of time" on employment schemes, which she said would ultimately fail. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. In an interview recorded on Tuesday, Skills Minister Jacqui Smith told the BBC that young people had a "responsibility" to take up employment support. "It is a contract. People need the chance, and they need to take that chance," she added. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disability benefits is also expected to be published this month.
