Zirvede iklim finansmanı, enerji güvenliği ve sanayinin yeşil dönüşümü öne çıkarken, iş dünyasının iklim hedeflerinin hayata geçirilmesindeki rolüne dikkat çekildi.
news.articleText: Cevdet Yılmaz'dan COP31 mesajı: "Özel sektör olmadan iklim hedeflerine ulaşılamaz" - Antalya'da düzenlenen COP31 İş ve Yatırım Zirvesi'nde 55'i aşkın ülkeden bin 500’ün üzerinde katılımcı bir araya geldi. - Zirvede iklim finansmanı, enerji güvenliği ve sanayinin yeşil dönüşümü öne çıkarken, iş dünyasının iklim hedeflerinin hayata geçirilmesindeki rolüne dikkat çekildi. Türkiye Odalar ve Borsalar Birliği (TOBB) koordinasyonunda düzenlenen COP31 İş ve Yatırım Zirvesi, 12 Kasım’da Antalya’da başladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle "Hedeften Uygulamaya" temasıyla gerçekleştirilen zirvede, iklim hedeflerinin yatırım projelerine dönüştürülmesi, enerji dönüşümü, sanayinin karbonsuzlaştırılması ve dirençli şehirler ele alındı. Zirvenin açılışında konuşan Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz, yeşil dönüşümün fosil yakıt ithalatını azaltarak makroekonomik istikrara katkı sağlayacağını belirtti. İklim hedeflerine ulaşılması için finansmana hazır projelerin ve kamu-özel sektör iş birliğinin önemini vurgulayan Yılmaz, özel sektörün sürece dahil edilmediği iklim politikalarının başarılı olamayacağını söyledi. COP31 Başkanı ve Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanı Murat Kurum ise zirveyi bir “uygulama COP’u” olarak konumlandırdıklarını ifade etti. Kurum, 2035’e kadar nihai enerji tüketiminde elektriğin payını yüzde 35’e, üretim ve imalatta döngüsel malzeme kullanımını en az yüzde 15’e çıkarma hedeflerini açıkladı. İklim Uygulama Köprüsü aracılığıyla ülkelerin önceliklerini yatırım yapılabilir projelere dönüştürmeyi amaçladıklarını belirtti. Hisarcıklıoğlu: "İklim eylemi en büyük yatırım fırsatı" TOBB Başkanı ve COP31 İş Forumu Başkanı Rifat Hisarcıklıoğlu, iklim hedeflerine müzakere salonlarında değil, fabrikalarda, tarlalarda ve şantiyelerde ulaşılabileceğini söyledi. İş dünyasının iklim eylemi açısından merkezi bir rol üstlendiğini belirten Hisarcıklıoğlu, iklim eyleminin bir maliyet değil, neslin en büyük yatırım fırsatı olduğunu vurguladı. Hisarcıklıoğlu, bu fırsatın hayata geçirilmesi için teknolojinin yanı sıra net ve istikrarlı politikalara, hızlı izin süreçlerine ve adil rekabete ihtiyaç duyulduğunu kaydetti. Dünya Bankası Başkanı'ndan özel sektör sermayesi vurgusu Zirvede düzenlenen oturumda konuşan Dünya Bankası Grubu Başkanı Ajay Banga, iklim yatırımlarının ekonomik getiriler ve genç istihdamı odağında değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti. BBVA Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Carlos Torres Vila ise gelişmekte olan ülkelerde KOBİ’lerin yeşil finansmana erişiminin önemine dikkat çekti. Vila, enerji verimliliği, elektrifikasyon, akıllı şebekeler ve yapay zekanın Türkiye gibi yüksek potansiyele sahip ülkelerin rekabet gücünü artırabileceğini ifade etti. Enerji güvenliği ve sanayinin dönüşümü gündemde Zirvenin oturumlarında enerji arz güvenliği, elektrifikasyon, iklim yatırımlarının finansmanı ve sanayinin karbonsuzlaştırılması da ele alındı. Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar, IEA İcra Direktörü Fatih Birol ve BBVA Grup CEO’su Onur Genç enerji güvenliğini değerlendirirken, Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanı Mehmet Fatih Kacır ile Sabancı Holding CEO’su Kıvanç Zaimler elektrifikasyon başlığında görüşlerini paylaştı. Londra Belediye Başkanı Sadiq Khan ise şehirlerin iklim mücadelesindeki rolüne dikkat çekerek, dünya nüfusunun yarısından fazlasının şehirlerde yaşadığını ve enerjinin yüzde 70’inden fazlasının şehirlerde tüketildiğini söyledi. Khan, şehirlerin iklim krizinde ya sorunun parçası ya da çözümün kendisi olabileceğini ifade etti. COP31 İş ve Yatırım Zirvesi, 13 Kasım’da döngüsel ekonomi, KOBİ’lerin yeşil dönüşümü, iklim teknolojileri ve COP32 sürecine ilişkin oturumlarla devam edecek.

news.title: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express
news.summary: North Korean hackers launch memecoins to launder funds stolen in the Binance hack, while xStocks plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express
news.summaryTr: North Korean hackers launch memecoins to launder funds stolen in the Binance hack, while xStocks plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks.
news.articleText: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express North Korean hackers launch memecoins to launder funds stolen in the Binance hack, while xStocks plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks. North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds North Korean hackers created memecoins to launder cryptocurrency stolen in the $6.3 billion Binance hack, according to a report from blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the hackers created at least six tokens on NEAR and used liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges to move $430,000 of stolen funds between wallets, Elliptic said. However, the tokens attracted almost no outside trading and were abandoned shortly after launch. Elliptic said the same laundering technique was also used following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, when North Korean-linked actors moved at least $24 million through a newly created token on the TRON blockchain. HONG KONG Hong Kong’s wealthy investors are embracing crypto. (Chi Hung Wong) xStocks tokenizes 200 stocks in UK and EU, with hundreds from Hong Kong coming soon Kraken parent Payward’s xStocks platform has added tokenized versions of more than 200 stocks listed in the United Kingdom and European Union. Payward said the latest expansion brings xStocks’ offering to more than 1,500 tokenized assets. The company reported more than $45 billion in cumulative transaction volume and over 550,000 unique holders. Payward said it plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks. Hong Kong’s forthcoming crypto licensing regime Deputy Secretary for Financial Services Chan Ho-lim told FinTech Week the region will introduces a new licensing regime for virtual-asset trading, custody, advisory and management, via amendment bills that will be submitted to Legislative Council this year. More Hong Kong news Police have arrested 22 people in a cross border money laundering investigation, that allegedly involved a over the counter crypto network that moved more than HKD$150 million (US$18 million) while attempting to obscure the origin of funds. Meanwhile, the US has sanctioned 41 entities allegedly linked to the Cambodia’s Prince Group, including a man named Qiu Yong, who is accused of running Hong Kong companies on behalf of the criminal organization. SOUTH KOREA South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats South Korea’s Financial Services Commission (FSC) plans to allow crypto exchanges to suspend deposits and withdrawals when hacking is suspected, rather than waiting until a breach is confirmed. The FSC said it would issue a no-action letter permitting preventive suspensions under certain conditions. Current rules prohibit exchanges from blocking withdrawals without legitimate grounds and explicitly allow restrictions only when a hacking incident is clearly established. The regulator also called for round-the-clock monitoring and incident response, higher cold-wallet holdings, and stronger insurance coverage and reserves. GOPAX puts everything on ice South Korean crypto exchange GOPAX announced on November 6 it was suspending trading, deposits and withdrawals and moving all user assets to cold wallets. The firm had received threatening emails that claimed a hack was imminent, and took the drastic step of putting everything on ice on the recommendation of financial authorities. JAPAN Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital Japanese financial services giant Nomura Holdings is reportedly weighing a sale of its cryptocurrency subsidiary Laser Digital as Nomura’s European operations continue to post losses. Nomura has held talks with potential buyers, including Marex Group but is yet to make a final decision and could keep the business. Nomura’s European businesses posted a pretax loss of 7.4 billion yen ($46.5 million) in the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026, their fourth consecutive quarterly loss. The company posted pretax profits in every other reporting region over the same period. THAILAND Thailand is examining new rules for ETFs and ICO investors (Sasint) Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals Thailand’s securities regulator has proposed capping daily stablecoin deposits and withdrawals at 5 million baht ($148,000) each per customer at regulated crypto operators. The limit would apply separately to deposits and withdrawals at each operator, Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said in a Thursday announcement. The regulator said the rules aim to curb money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to bypass cross-border money transfer rules. The draft would bar stablecoin transfers to and from third-party wallets. More Thailand news Thailand’s SEC will block access to Bitget from December 5. It has also proposed new tests for retail investors before allowing them to invest in ICOs. The tests would require knowledge of at least six areas including digital tokens and investor rights, blockchain technology, digital-asset wallets and distribution channels. The proposals will be up for comment until November 25. The SEC is also seeking feedback on new rules around margin loans and ETFs, but has ruled out allowing leveraged or crypto ETFs at this stage. Vietnam South Korean crypto firm Bithumb Asset, has invested $85 million into a luxury resort project in Hoi An in Vietnam being built by local real estate developer Asia Estate. Da Nang police have issued a warning about scams via “ghost” cryptocurrency projects that are really just ponzi schemes in disguise. They highlighted a fraud ring involving the DRK cryptocurrency project, led by Huynh Duc Van, 33, and seven accomplices, which was recently dealt with by law enforcement. SINGAPORE Nomura’s former head of crypto derivatives trading, John Kim, has joined Chicago-based DV Trading in Singapore to lead a new discretionary crypto-trading team. A Singapore woman lost S$78,000 (US$60,391) in a four-month long crypto scam after someone posing as an insurance buyer “helped” her to set up a crypto wallet. She initially believed she was making money, before getting cleared out after she was directed to the little known Qevorinex platform. International bank communication network Swift argued at Singapore FinTech Festival for shared standards to prevent digital assets from fragmenting across incompatible systems.

news.articleText: Trump'tan Küba'ya gözdağı: "Görev sürem bitmeden halletmek istiyorum" - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Küba'ya yönelik askeri müdahale seçeneğini dışlamadı. Trump, 2028'de görev süresi sona ermeden önce Küba meselesini çözmek istediğini söyledi. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Küba'ya yönelik olası bir askeri operasyon hakkında açıklamalarda bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Salem News Channel'a telefonla bağlanan Trump, görev süresi dolmadan önce Küba meselesini halletmek istediğini belirtti. Küba'yı "başarısız bir ülke" olarak nitelendiren Trump, ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio'nun süreci iyi yönettiğini ve gelişmeleri yakından takip ettiklerini söyledi. Küba'ya askeri güç kullanılıp kullanılmayacağına ilişkin soruyu yanıtlayan Trump, sınırlı bir operasyon seçeneğine de açık olduğunu ifade etti. Trump, "Bunun için biraz askeri güç gerekse, zayıf bir operasyon olsa bile, sizin için sorun olur mu?" sorusuna, "Benim için uygundur, bunu kesinlikle değerlendiririm." yanıtını verdi. ABD ile Küba arasındaki ilişkiler, 1959 Küba Devrimi'nden bu yana ambargo ve siyasi gerilimlerle şekilleniyor. Washington yönetimi, 1960'lardan itibaren Küba'ya yönelik ekonomik yaptırımlar uyguluyor.

news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Nvidia shares plunged after co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and left the board. Coinbase’s head of EU policy said tighter DeFi rules could push users toward riskier platforms. Binance’s security chief warned about fake job interviews months before attackers used a similar tactic in the exchange’s $6.3 billion hack. Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO and stepped down from the company’s board on Thursday, effective immediately. The board named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO. Kress will retain her role as CFO while Nvidia’s board considers internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO role. The board also appointed Harvey C. Jones its first chair and said it expects Nvidia’s operations to proceed without interruption. Nvidia shares fell more than 13% shortly after the US market opened on Thursday, trading at $151.00 as of 2:31 p.m. UTC, according to Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin (BTC) fell alongside Nvidia shares, dropping as much as 3.5% to a multimonth low. The shares later pared losses to trade at $165 at 4:24 p.m. UTC, down 5% on the day. The stock was down more than 26% over the previous month. EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec European Union efforts to tighten oversight of decentralized finance (DeFi) could drive crypto users toward platforms offering fewer investor protections, according to Coinbase’s head of EU policy. Roeland Van der Stappen told Cointelegraph that regulated crypto platforms could respond by limiting or dropping access to DeFi services. “Rules designed to protect investors would end up pushing activity towards the places with the least protection,” Van der Stappen said. In its September response to the European Commission’s consultation on the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), the European Securities and Markets Authority recommended creating a new category of regulated crypto services for firms that give customers access to DeFi protocols. Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack Months before Binance lost $6.3 billion to a hack, its chief security officer described to Cointelegraph how a fake job interview could give attackers a foothold inside the exchange — closely resembling one of the entry methods later used against the exchange. During a July interview about Binance’s response to rising security threats, Jimmy Su told Cointelegraph that fake job interviews were “something we worry about a lot internally,” explaining how attackers could tailor a job opportunity to an employee before persuading them to run code as part of a technical assessment. “And once that gets executed, the device is compromised and then they can start harvesting credentials,” Su said, adding that attackers could then use that to penetrate further into the network. Su’s detailed warning about malicious coding assessments was not included in Cointelegraph’s July coverage, but takes on new significance following the biggest crypto exchange hack in history.

news.title: Zayıflama ilaçlarında kalıcı görme kaybı riski: FDA'dan yeni uyarı
news.summary: FDA, Ozempic, Wegovy ve Mounjaro gibi popüler diyabet ve zayıflama ilaçlarının nadir ancak kalıcı görme kaybına yol açabilen bir göz rahatsızlığıyla ilişkili olabileceği uyarısıyla güvenlik etiketlerine yeni bilgiler eklenmesini istedi.

news.titleTr: Zayıflama ilaçlarında kalıcı görme kaybı riski: FDA'dan yeni uyarı
news.summaryTr: FDA, Ozempic, Wegovy ve Mounjaro gibi popüler diyabet ve zayıflama ilaçlarının nadir ancak kalıcı görme kaybına yol açabilen bir göz rahatsızlığıyla ilişkili olabileceği uyarısıyla güvenlik etiketlerine yeni bilgiler eklenmesini istedi.
news.articleText: Zayıflama ilaçlarında kalıcı görme kaybı riski: FDA'dan yeni uyarı - FDA, Ozempic, Wegovy ve Mounjaro gibi popüler diyabet ve zayıflama ilaçlarının nadir ancak kalıcı görme kaybına yol açabilen bir göz rahatsızlığıyla ilişkili olabileceği uyarısıyla güvenlik etiketlerine yeni bilgiler eklenmesini istedi. ABD Gıda ve İlaç Dairesi (FDA), diyabet tedavisinde ve kilo verme amacıyla kullanılan bazı popüler ilaçların nadir görülen ve kalıcı görme kaybına neden olabilen bir göz hastalığıyla ilişkili olabileceği uyarısında bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kurum, GLP-1 grubu ilaçların güvenlik etiketlerine olası riske ilişkin yeni uyarılar eklenmesini zorunlu kıldı. FDA'nın açıklamasına göre, glukagon benzeri peptit-1 reseptör agonisti (GLP-1 RA) grubundaki ilaçlar, "arteritik olmayan anterior iskemik optik nöropati" (NAION) adı verilen göz rahatsızlığıyla bağlantılı olabilir. Görme sinirine giden kan akışının azalmasıyla ortaya çıkan NAION, genellikle tek gözde ani ve ağrısız görme kaybına yol açıyor. Açıklamada, mevcut tedavilerle kaybedilen görmeyi geri kazandırdığı bilinen bir yöntemin bulunmadığı belirtildi. Birçok ilacın etiketine eklenecek FDA, Novo Nordisk'in Ozempic ve Wegovy, Eli Lilly'nin Mounjaro ve Zepbound ile Sanofi'nin Soliqua ilaçları dahil olmak üzere GLP-1 etkisi gösteren tüm ilaçların güvenlik etiketlerinde olası riske yer verilmesini istedi. Diyabet ve obezite hastalarında NAION riskinin zaten yüksek olduğuna dikkat çeken kurum, söz konusu ilaçların da bu hastalıkların tedavisinde kullanıldığını hatırlattı. Novo Nordisk ise ABC News'e yaptığı açıklamada, mevcut araştırmaların GLP-1 grubu ilaçların NAION'a neden olduğunu ortaya koymadığını savundu. 100 bin kişide vaka sayısı 6,4 olarak hesaplandı FDA, GLP-1 grubu ilaçlarla NAION arasındaki olası ilişkiyi, 2024'te JAMA Ophthalmology dergisinde yayımlanan bir araştırmanın ardından incelemeye aldı. Araştırmada, Ozempic ve Wegovy'nin etken maddesi semaglutid kullanan hastalarda NAION görülme riskinin arttığına işaret edilmişti. Kurumun incelemesinde, GLP-1 grubu ilaçları kullanan her 100 bin kişi başına bir yıllık dönemde ortalama 6,4 NAION vakası tespit edildi. Başka diyabet ilaçları veya plasebo kullananlarda ise bu sayı 3,8 olarak kaydedildi. NAION, görme sinirinin kanlanmasının bozulmasıyla ortaya çıkan ve çoğunlukla tek gözde ani görme kaybına neden olan bir rahatsızlık. FDA'nın uyarısı, ilaçların bu hastalığa kesin olarak neden olduğunun kanıtlandığı anlamına gelmiyor; olası riskin güvenlik etiketlerinde belirtilmesini amaçlıyor.

news.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
news.summary: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.

news.titleTr: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
news.summaryTr: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.
news.articleText: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations. Prediction market platform Kalshi has ended its advisory relationship with Donald Trump Jr. after his venture capital firm increased its investment in rival Polymarket, Reuters reported Thursday. A Kalshi spokesperson told Reuters that talks about ending Trump Jr.’s advisory role began in August, after Trump Jr.’s venture capital firm, 1789 Capital, took the lead on Polymarket’s $1 billion funding round. The round would value the company at $21 billion, with 1789 Capital set to contribute about $300 million. “We have mutually agreed to end Don’s advisory role after his firm’s significant investment in a competitor this past summer,” the spokesperson said. Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025 and received an equity stake reportedly worth $300,000 at the time, according to the Financial Times. Kalshi’s spokesperson said political considerations played no role in the decision. Two people familiar with the matter told Reuters, however, that some within Kalshi had raised concerns about what Democrats’ midterm sweep of both chambers of Congress could mean for the company. news.title: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off
news.summary: Strategy shares declined Thursday following MSCI’s decision to remove the company from its indexes, as Bitcoin also fell amid a broader crypto market decline.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off
news.summaryTr: Strategy shares declined Thursday following MSCI’s decision to remove the company from its indexes, as Bitcoin also fell amid a broader crypto market decline.
news.articleText: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off Strategy shares declined Thursday following MSCI’s decision to remove the company from its indexes, as Bitcoin also fell amid a broader crypto market decline. Shares of Michael Saylor’s Bitcoin treasury company Strategy fell 6.49% on Thursday, closing at $114.41, a day after MSCI confirmed the company’s removal from its global equity indexes and amid a broader cryptocurrency market sell-off. On Wednesday, MSCI confirmed that Strategy would be removed from its global equity indexes after the Nov. 30 market close, a move that could trigger selling by funds tracking the benchmarks. JPMorgan previously estimated that the exclusion could result in roughly $2.8 billion in selling pressure. Source: Yahoo Finance Ryan Kirkley, CEO of Global Settlement Network, told Cointelegraph that MSCI’s decision could help distinguish Bitcoin treasury companies from traditional operating businesses and limit indirect cryptocurrency exposure for passive investors. “Index inclusion meant ordinary passive investors, like someone holding a global index fund in their pension, were getting leveraged Bitcoin exposure they never chose. MSCI just fixed that,” he said. Kirkley added that MSCI’s decision also raises broader questions about whether Bitcoin treasury companies should be classified alongside traditional operating businesses. MSCI has said publicly what many people in institutional finance have been saying privately for a while: buying an asset and holding it isn’t an operating business. It’s a fund that doesn’t follow fund rules. In its Aug. 31 response to MSCI’s proposed rules, Strategy argued that the changes were a pretext for targeting digital asset treasury companies. It also downplayed the potential financial impact, saying MSCI-linked funds held approximately 13 million of its shares, representing just 3.1% of its basic shares outstanding. The stock’s decline coincided with a broader cryptocurrency market sell-off. Bitcoin traded near $71,340 as of 4:08 p.m. ET on Thursday, down 4.3% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko data. The total cryptocurrency market capitalization declined 3% to around $2.49 trillion. Magazine: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss

news.summaryTr: Elon Musk'ın uzay şirketi SpaceX, Texas ve Arizona'da kurulması planlanan iki süper bilgisayar tesisi için 74 milyar dolardan fazla yatırım yapmayı hedefliyor. Projelerin binlerce kişiye istihdam sağlaması bekleniyor.
news.articleText: SpaceX'ten iki eyalette dev yatırım: 74 milyar doları aşacak - Elon Musk'ın uzay şirketi SpaceX, Texas ve Arizona'da kurulması planlanan iki süper bilgisayar tesisi için 74 milyar dolardan fazla yatırım yapmayı hedefliyor. - Projelerin binlerce kişiye istihdam sağlaması bekleniyor. SpaceX, ABD'nin Texas ve Arizona eyaletlerinde iki büyük süper bilgisayar tesisi kurmak için toplam 74 milyar doları aşan yatırım planını duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin açıklamasına göre, Texas'ın Rio Grande Vadisi'ndeki Starbase bölgesine 24 milyar doların üzerinde, Arizona'nın Cochise County bölgesine ise yaklaşık 50 milyar dolarlık yatırım yapılacak. Texas projesi 3 binden fazla kişiye iş sağlayacak SpaceX, Starbase'de süper bilgisayar altyapısı için planlanan yatırımın inşaat aşamasında 3 binden fazla kişiye istihdam sağladığını, tesis faaliyete geçtiğinde ise 500'den fazla kalıcı iş oluşturmasının beklendiğini bildirdi. Tesisin kendi elektriğini üreteceği belirtilirken, Brownsville kentinin su ve atık su altyapısının genişletilmesi için 220 milyon dolarlık yatırım taahhüt edildi. Arizona'da 50 milyar dolarlık tesis Arizona'daki projenin inşaat aşamasında yaklaşık 5 bin 500, işletme döneminde ise 1000 kalıcı istihdam yaratması öngörülüyor. SpaceX, yerel elektrik kooperatifleriyle yürütülecek projeyle enerji altyapısının güçlendirilmesini ve elektrik faturalarının potansiyel olarak yüzde 20'ye kadar düşürülmesini hedefliyor. Tesisin kuru soğutma sistemiyle çalışacağı ve endüstriyel amaçlarla yer altı suyu kullanılmayacağı belirtildi. Starbase kentinde ayrıca doğalgazla çalışan bir elektrik santrali kurulması planlanıyor. Projeye ilişkin emlak vergisi indirimi ve ekonomik kalkınma anlaşmasının 9 Aralık'ta yapılacak Kent Komisyonu toplantısında değerlendirilmesi bekleniyor.

news.title: Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off
news.summary: The 72-year-old is believed to have gone overboard from the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off
news.summaryTr: The 72-year-old is believed to have gone overboard from the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.
news.articleText: Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off - Published The search for a British woman who is believed to have gone overboard from a cruise ship while it was crossing the Atlantic has been suspended, the US Coast Guard (USCG) has said. The 72-year-old was last seen aboard Tui's Marella Voyager on Monday while the vessel was en route to the Caribbean. Staff realised she was missing on Tuesday, when they noticed her "bed untouched". USCG said the ship was approximately 500 nautical miles from the area where she was believed to entered the water when it received a missing report. It added that a coordinated international search and rescue effort had been called off on Wednesday due to factors including "the low likelihood of survival". USCG said the woman was last recorded accessing a cabin door at about midday on Monday. She is believed to have gone overboard in a remote area of the North Atlantic, roughly 1,400 nautical miles from Bermuda. In a previous statement, Tui said that after staff realised she was missing, the alarm was raised and a search carried out. The Daily Mail earlier reported that holidaymakers on board the ship had been told to abandon dinners, drinks and entertainment as the crew carried out an emergency headcount on Tuesday evening. Passengers stood in lines of four while staff scanned boarding cards to verify the identity of every person on the ship, according to the newspaper. In a statement, USCG confirmed it had received a missing report at about 19:30 EST (00:30 GMT) on Tuesday. The coast guard said staff also reported that the Marella did not have enough fuel to return to the search area. It is understood that USCG asked the ship to continue its crossing rather than reverse course and search for the woman. It said that volunteers from the coast guard then worked with search and rescue partners including the Maritime Rescue Coordination Center Delgada and the UK's Joint Rescue Coordination Centre, and issued urgent maritime broadcasts requesting assistance from ships in the area. It added that multiple commercial vessels were contacted as part of the operation to "consider search opportunities, but none were in the vicinity". Search efforts were suspended at about 15:50 EST (20:50 GMT) on Wednesday, "after considering the extensive search area, the elapsed time between the presumed incident and notification, the lack of available search assets in the remote location, negative results from maritime broadcasts, the sea state, and the low likelihood of survival", the coast guard said. The Marella Voyager, carrying around 2,000 passengers and 800 crew, left Malaga on 4 November and is due to arrive in Antigua on Friday before calling at Dominica and finishing its voyage in Barbados on Sunday. A spokeswoman for Marella Cruises earlier said it was supporting the authorities with their enquiries. It added it was "deeply saddened" by the disappearance, adding: "Our thoughts are with the guest's loved ones at this very difficult time. A UK Foreign Office spokesperson said in an earlier statement: "We are supporting the family of a British national reported missing on a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean and we are in touch with the relevant authorities." In a separate case, a cruise ship pianist was found treading water on Sunday around 20 miles off the Californian coast after falling overboard. Two fishermen discovered the Royal Caribbean employee near Catalina Island and officials believe he may have been in the Pacific Ocean for nine hours, according to CBS News, the BBC's US news partner. news.titleTr: Borsa İstanbul'da 5 şirket yeni iş ilişkisi duyurdu: İşte KAP'a bildirilen sözleşme detayları
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul’da 12 Kasım'da 5 şirket yeni iş ilişkisi, sözleşme, yatırım, varlık satışı ve ihale gelişmelerini duyurdu. Açıklamalarda milyonlarca dolarlık ve milyarlarca liralık işlemler öne çıktı.
news.articleText: Borsa İstanbul'da 5 şirket yeni iş ilişkisi duyurdu: İşte KAP'a bildirilen sözleşme detayları Borsa İstanbul’da 12 Kasım'da 5 şirket yeni iş ilişkisi, sözleşme, yatırım, varlık satışı ve ihale gelişmelerini duyurdu. Açıklamalarda milyonlarca dolarlık ve milyarlarca liralık işlemler öne çıktı. GESAN'dan 171,6 milyon TL'lik ilave sipariş Girişim Elektrik, daha önce imzaladığı reaktif güç kompanzasyon sistemleri sözleşmeleri kapsamında Başkent EDAŞ ve Toroslar EDAŞ'tan ilave sipariş aldı. Vergiler hariç siparişlerin 26,76 milyon TL'lik kısmı işçilik, 2,88 milyon dolarlık (güncel kurla 171,58 milyon TL) kısmı ise malzeme tedarikinden oluştu. Malzeme kapsamındaki ürünlerin, şirketin bağlı ortaklığı Europower Enerji tarafından üretileceği bildirildi. TCKRC 173 milyon TL'lik ihaleyi kazandı Kıraç Galvaniz, 23 Ekim 2026'da gerçekleştirilen Karayolları 4. Bölge Müdürlüğünün çelik otokorkuluk yapım ihalesinin şirket uhdesinde kaldığını açıkladı. 173 milyon TL bedelli ihaleye ilişkin kesinleşme kararı şirkete ulaştı. Nihai sözleşme sürecine ilişkin gelişmelerin kamuoyuyla paylaşılacağı bildirildi. MİA Teknoloji'den TCDD projesinde 18,3 milyon TL'lik tamamlanma MİA Teknoloji, TCDD 4. Bölge Müdürlüğü sorumluluk alanındaki demiryolu hatlarının mobil haritalama yöntemiyle envanter tespiti ve ölçümüne ilişkin projeyi tamamladı. İş artışı ve KDV dahil projenin toplam tamamlanma bedeli 18 milyon 349 bin 470,24 TL oldu. Şirket, projenin kabul işlemlerinin de sonuçlandığını bildirdi. KARÇEL'den 19,8 milyon euroluk yatırım kredisi Kardemir Çelik, Haddehane Modernizasyon Projesi kapsamında DZ Bank AG ile 19 milyon 774 bin 166 euro tutarında kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. Çin İhracat ve Kredi Sigorta Kuruluşu Sinosure sigortası kapsamında sağlanan kredinin geri ödeme vadesi 12 yıl olarak belirlendi. Şirket, yatırımla üretim altyapısını modernize etmeyi, operasyonel verimliliği artırmayı ve üretimin çevresel etkilerini azaltmayı hedefliyor. Yatırımın orta ve uzun vadede maliyet yapısı ile kârlılığa katkı sağlaması bekleniyor. ORGE'nin hastane projesinde sözleşme büyüklüğü arttı Orge Enerji, devam eden Anatolia Antalya ve Anatolia Alanya Hastaneleri Projesi'nde sözleşme büyüklüğünün arttığını açıkladı. Buna göre, başlangıçta 589 bin 712 euro ve 46 milyon 77 bin 269 TL olan sözleşme tutarı, kesilen faturalarla 1 milyon 180 bin 885 euro ve 92 milyon 973 bin 275 TL'ye ulaştı.

news.titleTr: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow
news.summaryTr: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
news.articleText: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow - Published US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held a fresh round of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, a day after the latest discussions aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi. The pair are now in Dublin to meet Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, and Witkoff said a new round of trilateral talks had already been agreed with Putin. But in a sign of further tension, Zelensky said on Thursday morning that Ukraine's military was again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The peace talks in the Emirates were framed as being centred around European security arrangements in a post-war scenario, although a resolution to the war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 still appears distant. Comments by both President Vladimir Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider. Witkoff said that Europeans would join the next round of talks. "They are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin. Prime Minister Andy Burnham had said that UK national security adviser Jonathan Powell would join Zelensky, Witkoff and Kushner for talks in Dublin, but Downing Street later said they had been delayed, meaning the national security adviser could no longer join. Earlier on Thursday, Zelensky said Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side but added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going." He did not elaborate further. Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line. A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed and it remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions. - Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap? - Published25 October Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine". Meanwhile, some of the longstanding roadblocks in the peace process were addressed during the US-Russia talks in the Kremlin. The territorial issue continues to be a key point of contention, Putin said. "For us there is only one line of demarcation: the line of the state border. Because then it will be clear that we are here, and you are there. As soon as we start discussing 'grey zones'… arguments immediately start and any agreements become unstable. And there will be no lasting peace." He also suggested organising a humanitarian truce to allow for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from a frontline area, on the model of last month's ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Putin suggested a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk. Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it. "Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn told the BBC, adding that the details would need to be "clarified". But at the core of this week's talks has been the issue of European security architecture. Earlier Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said it was "clear that the current system does not work." Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin and that decisions about their continent could be made without them. Zelensky said he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia "a bit strange". "It is a significant shift in the US position that the US has now taken on board the Russian demand that the European security architecture needs to be discussed and agreed upon in parallel with the Ukraine peace talks," said the Director of the Estonian Foreign Policy Institute Kristi Raik. She said the Russians have a "long history" of wanting to revise European security architecture, intended as core principles "like sovereignty, territorial integrity, the principle that there is no use of force to some conflicts". Russia "has long looked to reduced Nato presence on the Eastern flank and that… get some kind of veto rights in decisions concerning European security and defence," Raik said. "And that's where it gets even more difficult to imagine that there could be an agreement between the Europeans and the Russians." On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war". During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. That position has now shifted for many as concern that decisions about the European continent could be made without European involvement. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. Top EU diplomat Kaja Kallas told the BBC's Newshour programme the presence of a European official at the next meeting showed the Kremlin had "now realised that Europe is a big player here because we are the ones who have been supporting Ukraine". With financial pressures on European budgets, Kallas said it was "becoming harder to help Ukraine", but warned of the "the danger not only for the eastern flank of the European Union but actually for our whole continent" if Russian aggression was allowed to continue. The Kremlin has not confirmed the make-up of next week's talks, and at the start of the meeting, Putin had indicated he didn't want European countries to play a full role. The Russians have long cited Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle to their involvement. Speaking to Kushner and Witkoff, Putin said he was encouraging them "to work with your European allies so that they finally decide whether they want peace or war in Ukraine." But in a sign of further tension, Zelensky said on Thursday morning that Ukraine's military was again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The peace talks in the Emirates were framed as being centred around European security arrangements in a post-war scenario, although a resolution to the war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 still appears distant. Comments by both President Vladimir Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider. Witkoff said that Europeans would join the next round of talks. "They are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin. Prime Minister Andy Burnham had said that UK national security adviser Jonathan Powell would join Zelensky, Witkoff and Kushner for talks in Dublin, but Downing Street later said they had been delayed, meaning the national security adviser could no longer join. Earlier on Thursday, Zelensky said Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side but added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going." He did not elaborate further. Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line. A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed and it remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions. - Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap? - Published25 October Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine". Meanwhile, some of the longstanding roadblocks in the peace process were addressed during the US-Russia talks in the Kremlin. The territorial issue continues to be a key point of contention, Putin said. "For us there is only one line of demarcation: the line of the state border. Because then it will be clear that we are here, and you are there. As soon as we start discussing 'grey zones'… arguments immediately start and any agreements become unstable. And there will be no lasting peace." He also suggested organising a humanitarian truce to allow for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from a frontline area, on the model of last month's ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Putin suggested a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk. Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it. "Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn told the BBC, adding that the details would need to be "clarified". But at the core of this week's talks has been the issue of European security architecture. Earlier Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said it was "clear that the current system does not work." Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin and that decisions about their continent could be made without them. Zelensky said he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia "a bit strange". "It is a significant shift in the US position that the US has now taken on board the Russian demand that the European security architecture needs to be discussed and agreed upon in parallel with the Ukraine peace talks," said the Director of the Estonian Foreign Policy Institute Kristi Raik. She said the Russians have a "long history" of wanting to revise European security architecture, intended as core principles "like sovereignty, territorial integrity, the principle that there is no use of force to some conflicts". Russia "has long looked to reduced Nato presence on the Eastern flank and that… get some kind of veto rights in decisions concerning European security and defence," Raik said. "And that's where it gets even more difficult to imagine that there could be an agreement between the Europeans and the Russians." On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war". During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. That position has now shifted for many as concern that decisions about the European continent could be made without European involvement. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. Top EU diplomat Kaja Kallas told the BBC's Newshour programme the presence of a European official at the next meeting showed the Kremlin had "now realised that Europe is a big player here because we are the ones who have been supporting Ukraine". With financial pressures on European budgets, Kallas said it was "becoming harder to help Ukraine", but warned of the "the danger not only for the eastern flank of the European Union but actually for our whole continent" if Russian aggression was allowed to continue. The Kremlin has not confirmed the make-up of next week's talks, and at the start of the meeting, Putin had indicated he didn't want European countries to play a full role. The Russians have long cited Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle to their involvement. Speaking to Kushner and Witkoff, Putin said he was encouraging them "to work with your European allies so that they finally decide whether they want peace or war in Ukraine." news.titleTr: US Justice Department, business groups and DeFi firms challenge Illinois crypto tax
news.summaryTr: Industry groups argued in court filings that Illinois’ crypto tax, which applies even when a transaction yields no profit, could raise compliance costs and violate federal law.
news.articleText: US Justice Department, business groups and DeFi firms challenge Illinois crypto tax Industry groups argued in court filings that Illinois’ crypto tax, which applies even when a transaction yields no profit, could raise compliance costs and violate federal law. The US Department of Justice, business and financial industry groups and a coalition of decentralized finance (DeFi) firms have backed a legal challenge to Illinois’ 0.2% digital asset tax, arguing that the measure unfairly targets cryptocurrency transactions and could impose taxes even when investors make no profit. Over the past week, the Justice Department filed a statement of interest, while the US Chamber of Commerce and the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) submitted an amicus filing. A coalition that includes venture capital firms Andreessen Horowitz and Paradigm as well as crypto protocols Uniswap and Aave Labs also filed a brief, according to a Thursday announcement from the Blockchain Association and Crypto Council for Innovation. The law, enacted in June, imposes a 0.2% tax on the value of digital assets exchanged, transferred or stored, regardless of whether a transaction generates a profit. The Digital Chamber sued Illinois Attorney General Kwame Raoul and state revenue official David Harris in July, followed by a separate challenge from the Blockchain Association and Crypto Council for Innovation in August. Originally scheduled to take effect on Jan. 1, 2027, the tax was delayed until July 1, 2027, allowing more time for the legal challenges. Illinois had projected the digital asset tax would generate $60 million in fiscal year 2027 revenue, according to estimates from the governor’s budget office. Illinois House Speaker Emanuel “Chris” Welch previously promoted the measure as part of a broader affordability agenda aimed at “closing corporate loopholes and making big tech companies and crypto billionaires pay their fair share,” the Chicago Tribune reported in July. Lawmakers involved in advancing the legislation and the governor’s office did not respond to Cointelegraph’s requests for comment before publication. Related: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals Business groups warn of crypto tax costs and legal violations In a Nov. 6 court filing, SIFMA and the US Chamber of Commerce warned that Illinois’ tax would affect banks, broker-dealers, custodians and asset managers across the country, potentially exposing them to significant compliance costs. They also highlighted the financial burden on customers. “This means that a customer who loses money owes the same tax as a customer who earns a profit,” the filing said. “And a customer who moves the same asset between two accounts faces tax (potentially on both ends) without a sale, a gain, or a change in beneficial ownership.” The groups said firms would need to develop systems to identify Illinois customers, value digital assets and determine which transactions are taxable, while facing potential criminal penalties for violations. They also argued that the tax discriminates against digital asset services because comparable transactions involving traditional assets are not taxed in the same way, potentially violating federal internet tax protections and constitutional requirements for interstate commerce and uniform taxation. DOJ challenges tax policy as DeFi firms warn of developer liability The Justice Department also weighed in on Nov. 6, saying that Illinois’ digital asset tax undermines federal efforts to promote cryptocurrency innovation and US leadership in the sector. The filing cited the creation of a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and the GENIUS Act, which established federal rules for stablecoins. The DOJ argued that less favorable tax treatment for digital assets could conflict with those policies. Separately, the DeFi coalition warned about who could be held responsible for collecting the tax. In a Nov. 11 filing, the group argued that Illinois’ proposed rules could impose obligations on software developers and other blockchain participants who lack customer information, control over user funds or the ability to collect taxes. news.title: ABD bütçesinde 2027 mali yılı hızlı başladı: Açıkta sert artış
news.summary: ABD federal hükümetinin bütçe açığı, 2027 mali yılının ilk ayında geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 42,1 artarak 404,1 milyar dolara ulaştı. Gelirler gerilerken harcamalardaki artış dikkat çekti.

news.titleTr: ABD bütçesinde 2027 mali yılı hızlı başladı: Açıkta sert artış
news.summaryTr: ABD federal hükümetinin bütçe açığı, 2027 mali yılının ilk ayında geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 42,1 artarak 404,1 milyar dolara ulaştı. Gelirler gerilerken harcamalardaki artış dikkat çekti.
news.articleText: ABD bütçesinde 2027 mali yılı hızlı başladı: Açıkta sert artış - ABD federal hükümetinin bütçe açığı, 2027 mali yılının ilk ayında geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 42,1 artarak 404,1 milyar dolara ulaştı. - Gelirler gerilerken harcamalardaki artış dikkat çekti. ABD federal hükümetinin bütçe açığı, 2027 mali yılının ilk ayı olan ekimde geçen yılın aynı dönemine kıyasla yüzde 42,1 yükseldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD Hazine Bakanlığı'nın yayımladığı bütçe dengesi raporuna göre açık, 404,1 milyar dolar olarak kaydedildi. Federal hükümet, 2026 mali yılının ekim ayında 284,3 milyar dolarlık bütçe açığı vermişti. Gelirler azaldı, harcamalar arttı Ekim ayında federal hükümetin gelirleri, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 8,8 azalarak 368,9 milyar dolara geriledi. Aynı dönemde harcamalar yüzde 12,2 artışla 773 milyar dolara yükseldi. ABD'nin 2027 mali yılı 1 Ekim 2026'da başladı ve 30 Eylül 2027'de sona erecek. Geçen mali yılda açık 1,99 trilyon dolara ulaşmıştı ABD federal hükümetinin bütçe açığı, 2026 mali yılında bir önceki yıla göre yüzde 12 artarak 1,99 trilyon dolara yükselmişti. Söz konusu tutar, Covid-19 salgınının etkili olduğu 2021 mali yılında kaydedilen 2,77 trilyon dolarlık açığın ardından son beş yılın en yüksek seviyesi olarak kayıtlara geçmişti. ABD'de mali yıl, her yıl 1 Ekim'de başlayıp sonraki yılın 30 Eylül'ünde sona eriyor. Federal bütçe açığı, hükümetin belirli bir dönemdeki harcamalarının gelirlerini aşmasıyla oluşuyor. Açığın büyümesi, kamu borçlanma ihtiyacını artırarak faiz giderleri üzerinde de baskı yaratabiliyor.

news.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
news.summary: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
news.summaryTr: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
news.articleText: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland - Published Finnish officials have confirmed that a Russian warship was attacked in the Gulf of Finland on Wednesday, although little is known about the strike. Ukraine's SBU security service said it targeted the ship Naro-Fominsk as part of a broader drone operation against Russia's Ust-Luga oil export depot on the Baltic coast. The attack, thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an area of the Baltic Sea open to civilian maritime traffic, has raised questions about whether Ukraine could expand its strikes. Helsinki has been one of Kyiv's closest European allies, and Finnish officials have described the incident as a direct result of Russia's continued full-scale war. Finland's military has given few details of the incident, but it appears to have taken place in a narrow stretch some distance from the Finnish coast. The country's Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen was adamant that the situation in the Baltic Sea remained stable and safe and that there was no threat of any kind to marine traffic. Defence officials are understood to have stressed to Kyiv that the Gulf is a relatively narrow waterway used by oil tankers and civilian vessels, and is also home to subsea data cables. Ukraine's SBU described the Russian ship as a Buyan-M type small corvette that carried Kalibr and Oniks cruise missiles. There were also unconfirmed reports of Russian combat helicopters being destroyed. Martin Herem, the defence minister of Estonia, which borders the Gulf, told public broadcaster ERR that the ship was hit at about 05:30 (03:30 GMT) on Wednesday but did not say how it was attacked: "We know that smoke came from the ship afterwards. The ship itself went back towards St Petersburg." The extent of casualties or damage sustained by the Russian navy ship remains unclear, and Moscow rarely gives such details. "The Baltic Sea fleet has been untouched up to this point but there seemingly was a window of opportunity for Ukraine and they understandably tried to use it," said military analyst Emil Kastehelmi, co-founder of the Black Bird monitoring group. Russian and Ukrainian vessels have been repeatedly targeted in the Black Sea since Russia's full-scale invasion began in February 2022, but even though the latest strike on a ship in the Baltic is unprecedented, Kastehelmi told the BBC he did not consider it a serious escalation. Ukrainian drones are regularly launched into Russia from northern Ukraine. Several storage tanks at the Ust-Luga terminal are thought to have been hit overnight on Wednesday and fires at the port were visible over the border in Estonia. Herem said Ukrainian drones attacked the Ust-Luga region from midnight until about 06:00, mostly flying close to the Estonian border but still in Russian airspace. He added that one drone had entered Estonian airspace briefly from Latvia and then headed towards Russia. Nato aircraft based in the Baltic states were in the air at the time, but Herem said it had not been considered safe for them to destroy the drones. Ukrainian foreign ministry spokesman Heorhiy Tykhyy said late on Wednesday that Moscow's allegations that Kyiv had used the airspace of the Baltic states to attack Russia were "baseless", although he acknowledged "incidents might occur when Russia diverts drones from its airspace using electronic warfare".

news.articleText: DTCC Plans Solana Expansion as Wallet Rules Limit Access The US securities clearinghouse plans to bring tokenized stocks to Solana in 2027, but analysts say restrictions could limit adoption. Plans by the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation’s (DTCC) to bring tokenized securities to Solana could attract more traditional financial institutions to the blockchain, but regulatory restrictions may limit the impact on the network, according to analysts. DTCC announced Thursday that it plans to connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027. The move would allow certain securities held by its Depository Trust Company (DTC) subsidiary to be turned into digital tokens on the network. Solana is a blockchain known for its fast transactions and low fees, making it popular for crypto trading, especially memecoins. The network had about $4.94 billion in total value locked (TVL) as of Nov. 12, according to DefiLlama. Experts say the move could help Solana attract more activity beyond just memecoins, but it’s not clear how much new capital and transaction volume it could bring to the network. What’s more, current US regulatory rules still limit who can hold and transfer the tokenized assets. Memes paved the way Alex Lin, founding partner at venture capital firm Reforge, said Solana’s history of handling large amounts of memecoin trading may have helped show that the network can support traditional financial activity. “Memes were a public stress test that gave Solana credibility that it can handle retail-scale volume cheaply and reliably,” Lin told Cointelegraph. “The casino paved the way for more institutional plumbing.” However, under a December 2025 SEC no-action letter, DTC participants must register wallets to hold tokenized securities. The tokens can only be transferred between registered wallets, potentially limiting usage. “It’s overstated in the near term because the SEC relief from Dec 2025 keeps these tokens in a walled garden of registered DTC participants, so permissionless retail and DeFi liquidity can’t touch these tokens directly yet,” Lin said. “Regulators need to let these assets work as true onchain collateral and that’s more policy than tech.” DTCC launched its tokenization service on the Canton Network and its private Besu network on Oct. 28, allowing certain securities to be turned into digital tokens while keeping the same investor protections. At launch, DTCC said 20 DTC participants had signed agreements to access the service, but it has not said whether any plan to use Solana. Cointelegraph contacted DTCC and the Solana Foundation for additional comments but has not yet heard back. Related: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’ Solana trading slows, but tokenized assets grow Kha Nguyen, CEO and co-founder of blockchain analytics platform Birdeye, which tracks trading activity on Solana, said the blockchain has already seen growing demand for tokenized stocks without DTCC’s involvement. According to Birdeye’s H1 2026 report, tokenized-stock trading volume on Solana reached around $4.9 billion in the first half of the year, more than six times the volume recorded in the previous six months. Birdeye’s third-quarter report also found that more than 1 million accounts held tokenized stocks on Solana by late September. Still, broader trading activity on Solana has slowed with the network recording about 6.9 billion transactions in the 30 days ending Nov. 11, down almost 40% from the previous 30-day period, according to Token Terminal data. Meanwhile, trading volume on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) fell 34.4% to $39.1 billion, while monthly active addresses dropped nearly 13% to 45.8 million. Network fees also fell 39% to about $17 million over the same period. However, the value of tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) on Solana rose almost 7% to $4.76 billion as of Nov. 11 – up from $4.46 billion on Oct. 12. “By late September more than a million wallets had held a tokenized stock, and real-world assets on Solana had grown five times in a year,” Nguyen told Cointelegraph. Nguyen said bringing more tokenized securities onto the network does not automatically mean more transactions or greater demand for Solana’s native cryptocurrency, SOL. “A trade is one transaction whether it moves $100 or $100 million,” Nguyen said. “What matters is turnover, not value parked on-chain.” What could happen next? Nguyen said DTCC’s integration would need support from banks and other financial firms to have a real impact on Solana. Institutions would also need enough liquidity to support large trades. “Banks, brokers and issuers need to say they will issue, trade and settle there, and then do it,” Nguyen said. He added that institutions would need to actively use the tokenized securities rather than simply hold them. “The assets must be active, not idle: traded around the clock, used as collateral to borrow against, and earning yield,” Nguyen said. Lin agreed that the longer-term impact would depend on how the assets are used, rather than which blockchain they are issued on. “No one cares where the assets are issued, but more so where they’re used,” Lin said. “It’s all about where secondary trading and collateral activity will happen and ultimately settle.” Magazine: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

news.summary: The BBC's Samira Hussain reports from Wall Street on what the fall of the tech superstar means for the company and AI.

news.titleTr: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?
news.summaryTr: The BBC's Samira Hussain reports from Wall Street on what the fall of the tech superstar means for the company and AI.
news.articleText: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia? Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of tech giant Nvidia, the company's board says, with chief financial officer Colette Kress appointed interim boss. The company's shares have recovered some ground after plummeting more than 13% when US markets opened shortly after news of Huang's resignation. The BBC's North America correspondent Samira Hussain explains what's next for the company. Read more about the rise and fall of Jensen Huang here.

news.title: MSCI kararı sonrası borsada çarpıcı tablo: 8 tavan, 1 taban
news.summary: MSCI'ın Türkiye endekslerinde yaptığı değişikliklerin ardından Borsa İstanbul'da ilgili hisselerde dikkat çeken hareketler yaşandı. Ana endeksten çıkarılan Astor Enerji tavan olurken Sabancı Holding geriledi. Small Cap Endeksi'nden çıkarılan 18 hissenin ise 15'i günü yükselişle tamamladı.

news.summaryTr: MSCI'ın Türkiye endekslerinde yaptığı değişikliklerin ardından Borsa İstanbul'da ilgili hisselerde dikkat çeken hareketler yaşandı. Ana endeksten çıkarılan Astor Enerji tavan olurken Sabancı Holding geriledi. Small Cap Endeksi'nden çıkarılan 18 hissenin ise 15'i günü yükselişle tamamladı.
news.articleText: MSCI kararı sonrası borsada çarpıcı tablo: 8 tavan, 1 taban MSCI'ın Türkiye endekslerinde yaptığı değişikliklerin ardından Borsa İstanbul'da ilgili hisselerde dikkat çeken hareketler yaşandı. Ana endeksten çıkarılan Astor Enerji tavan olurken Sabancı Holding geriledi. Small Cap Endeksi'nden çıkarılan 18 hissenin ise 15'i günü yükselişle tamamladı. Küresel endeks sağlayıcısı MSCI, Kasım 2026 dönemine ilişkin endeks değişikliklerini açıkladı. Türkiye endekslerinde yapılan düzenlemeler kapsamında Sabancı Holding (SAHOL) ve Astor Enerji (ASTOR), MSCI Turkey Index'ten çıkarılarak MSCI Turkey Small Cap Index'e dahil edildi. Küçük ölçekli şirketlerin yer aldığı MSCI Turkey Small Cap Endeksi'nden ise 18 şirketin hissesi çıkarıldı. Söz konusu değişikliklerin 30 Kasım 2026 Pazartesi günü seans kapanışından itibaren geçerli olacağı bildirildi. Kararın açıklanmasının ardından Borsa İstanbul'da gözler endeks değişikliğinden etkilenen 20 hisseye çevrildi. Hisselerin 12 Kasım'daki performansında yükselişler ağırlık kazanırken bazı şirketlerde sert satışlar dikkat çekti. Astor tavan oldu, Sabancı geriledi MSCI Türkiye ana endeksinden çıkarılarak küçük ölçekli şirketler endeksine alınan iki hissede farklı fiyat hareketleri görüldü. Astor Enerji hisseleri günü yüzde 9,99 yükselişle 177,20 TL'den tamamladı. Sabancı Holding hisseleri ise yüzde 1,92 değer kaybederek 84,50 TL'den kapandı. Endeksten çıkarılan 18 hissenin 15'i yükseldi MSCI Turkey Small Cap Endeksi'nden çıkarılan 18 şirketin hisselerinde ise yükselişler öne çıktı. Söz konusu hisselerin 15'i günü primle tamamlarken üçünde değer kaybı yaşandı. Odine Solutions yüzde 9,99, Altınkılıç Gıda yüzde 9,98, Lydia Holding yüzde 9,97, Pasifik Eurasia Lojistik yüzde 9,95, Işıklar Enerji yüzde 9,94 ve Tera Yatırım Teknoloji Holding yüzde 9,93 yükseliş kaydetti. Margün Enerji ve Peker GYO hisselerinde de yüzde 9'u aşan değer kazançları görüldü. Satış tarafında ise Ral Yatırım Holding yüzde 9,96 düşüşle dikkat çekti. Batısöke Çimento yüzde 8,26, Batıçim ise yüzde 4,50 değer kaybetti. MSCI kararı sonrası 20 hissenin kapanış performansı Gözler 30 Kasım'a çevrildi MSCI'ın endeks değişiklikleri 30 Kasım'da seans kapanışının ardından uygulanacak. Endeksleri takip eden uluslararası yatırım fonlarının portföylerinde yapacağı düzenlemeler nedeniyle ilgili hisselerdeki fiyat ve işlem hacmi hareketleri takip edilecek. Öte yandan Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi günü yüzde 1,24 yükselişle 11.811,19 puandan tamamladı. MSCI'ın endeks değişikliği kararına konu olan 20 hissenin dokuzunda günlük değer kazancı yüzde 9'u aştı.

news.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
news.summary: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
news.summaryTr: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
news.articleText: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools - Published Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations. Some 3,778 schools, from Milan in the north to Sicily in the south, reported similar threats to one that created chaos on Wednesday - even though no explosive devices have been found. The government has advised schools that "in the absence of concrete evidence beyond the simple receipt of a mass email indicating a danger, buildings must not not be evacuated". Unlike a day earlier, only 77 schools were evacuated on Thursday, authorities say. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says her government will come up with "sector-specific" advice to help those facing this kind of threat. Schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received threats on Wednesday, too. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected. On Thursday morning, a bomb alert at a Calais rail station delayed international and national train services in northern France. The latest incidents follow a series of bomb hoaxes last week against airports and airlines in a number of European countries. Although a number of threats were claimed by an extremist misogynistic group, it later denied any link to the false warnings. Wednesday's email threat - sent to 6,300 out of a total of 7,476 Italian state schools - was said to be from a certain "Mikhail Andropov, leader of Vilayat di Misoginistan". Some officials say it originated in Taiwan. A similar message sent to Italian schools on Thursday, again signed by Mikhail Andropov, is said to have been sent from the account of a teacher in the Philippines whose account is believed to have been hacked. Many parents, though, are concerned and have been demanding clarity and action from the government. La Repubblica newspaper reports that protests have been held against a decision by the headmaster of a secondary school in Rome who did not take any action, saying she had realised the threatening message to contain typos and therefore be "fake". According to the newspaper, protesters want new national guidelines to be issued. Related topics - Published6 days ago

news.title: BBVA CEO'su Onur Genç: "Problem teknoloji değil, finansman"
news.summary: BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç, enerji dönüşümünde mevcut teknolojilerin önemli bir ilerleme sağlamaya yeterli olduğunu, asıl meselenin projeleri finanse edilebilir hale getirmek olduğunu söyledi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: BBVA CEO'su Onur Genç: "Problem teknoloji değil, finansman"
news.summaryTr: BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç, enerji dönüşümünde mevcut teknolojilerin önemli bir ilerleme sağlamaya yeterli olduğunu, asıl meselenin projeleri finanse edilebilir hale getirmek olduğunu söyledi.
news.articleText: BBVA CEO'su Onur Genç: "Problem teknoloji değil, finansman" - BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç, enerji dönüşümünde mevcut teknolojilerin önemli bir ilerleme sağlamaya yeterli olduğunu, asıl meselenin projeleri finanse edilebilir hale getirmek olduğunu söyledi. - Garanti BBVA Genel Müdürü Mahmut Akten ise şirketlerin kredi talebinde temel sorunun limitlerden çok fiyatlama olduğunu belirterek, yüksek faizin bilançolar üzerinde ciddi yük oluşturduğunu vurguladı. BBVA CEO’su Onur Genç ve Garanti BBVA Genel Müdürü Mahmut Akten, Antalya’da COP31 kapsamında basın mensuplarıyla bir araya geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sohbetin gündeminde enerji dönüşümü ve sürdürülebilir finansmanın yanı sıra fon krizi, kredi koşulları, bankacılıkta karlılık ve 2027 beklentileri vardı. İki yöneticinin değerlendirmelerinde, Türkiye’nin enerji bağımlılığını azaltmasının hem ekonomik kırılganlıklarla mücadele hem de şirketlerin rekabet gücü açısından taşıdığı önem öne çıktı. BBVA’dan sürdürülebilir finansmanda 1 trilyon euroluk hedef Onur Genç’e göre sürdürülebilirlik, çevresel sorumluluğun ötesine geçerek ülkelerin ve şirketlerin rekabet gücünü belirleyen bir konuya dönüştü. Enerjide dışa bağımlılık, savaşlar ve tedarik sorunları karşısında ülkelerin maliyetlerini artırırken şirketler için de hem maliyetleri yönetme hem ihracat pazarlarını koruma ihtiyacı büyüyor. Genç, “Ülkeler eğer bu konuda yatırım yapmazlarsa ülke olarak rekabet avantajını kaybediyorlar. Şirketler eğer bu konuda yatırım yapmazlarsa hem pazarlarını hem de rekabet avantajlarını yine maliyet olarak kaybediyorlar.” dedi. Sürdürülebilirliği 2018’de stratejik öncelikleri arasına alan BBVA, başlangıçta 100 milyar euro olarak belirlediği finansman hedefini önce 200 milyar, ardından 300 milyar euroya yükseltti. Grup, 2018–2024 döneminde 300 milyar euroluk sürdürülebilir finansmanı yönlendirdi. 2025–2029 dönemi için buna 700 milyar euro daha eklenmesi planlanıyor. Böylece 2018–2029 dönemindeki toplam taahhüt 1 trilyon euroya ulaşıyor. Genç’in paylaştığı rakamlara göre, 2025 başından 2026 Eylül sonuna kadar yeni hedef kapsamında 250 milyar euroluk finansman sağlandı.
